public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(table_id uuid, hand_number bigint, game_scope jsonb, evidence jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET enable_nestloop TO 'off'
AS $function$ BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions LIMIT 0; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid='public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions'::regclass AND c.conname='union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions_check' AND c.contype='c' AND c.convalidated AND pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid)='CHECK ((proof_md5 = md5((proof)::text)))') OR (SELECT count(*)FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions'::regclass AND attname IN('proof','proof_md5')AND attnotnull AND NOT attisdropped)<>2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'linked_proof_contract_changed';END IF; RETURN QUERY EXECUTE $query$
 SELECT r.table_id,r.hand_number,r.game_scope,r.evidence
 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions r
 JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=r.table_id AND o.hand_number=r.hand_number
 WHERE r.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=$1::text AND o.recognized_at>=$2 AND o.recognized_at<$3
  AND r.hand_id=o.hand_id AND r.outcome_payload_hash=o.payload_hash AND r.outcome_evidence_md5=md5(o.evidence::text)
  
$query$ USING p_union_id,p_start,p_end;END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_original_flow_eviden.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_original_flow_evidence(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
  FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q WHERE q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
 ), rf_original_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.transaction_id,(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid table_id,
   (q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid user_id,(q.l->>'amount')::numeric amount
  FROM originals q
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
   AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
 ), rf_original_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount,count(*) refunds,
   min(o.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(o.user_id::text)::uuid player
  FROM rf_original_keys k
  JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.transaction_id=k.transaction_id
   AND a.refunded>0 AND a.refunded=k.amount
  JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts o ON o.id=a.funding_receipt_id
  WHERE a.pending_addon_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.pending_addon_id AND a.original_occupancy_id=o.occupancy_id
   AND o.table_id=k.table_id AND o.account_type='player_wallet' AND o.account_entity_id=k.user_id
   AND o.funding_club_id=k.club_id AND o.user_id=k.user_id
  GROUP BY k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount
 ), bbj_wallet_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.ledger_id,(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,r.user_id,r.amount,b.id payout_id
  FROM originals q
  JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=CASE WHEN q.l->>'idempotency_key' ~ '^bbj:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN split_part(q.l->>'idempotency_key',':',2)::uuid END
  JOIN public.bbj_payout_recipients r ON r.payout_id=b.id AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
  JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency w ON w.key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND w.user_id=r.user_id AND w.amount=r.amount
  JOIN public.bbj_pools pool ON pool.id=b.pool_id
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND q.l->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
   AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=b.table_id::text AND q.l->>'table_id'=b.table_id::text
   AND q.l->>'id'=q.ledger_id::text AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text
   AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND (pool.union_id=p_union_id OR (pool.union_id IS NULL AND pool.club_id::text=q.game_scope->>'host_club_id'))
   AND b.kind IN('main','mini') AND b.total_amount>0 AND b.total_amount=round(b.total_amount,2)
   AND b.created_at<=q.recognized_at AND r.created_at=w.created_at AND w.created_at>=b.created_at AND w.created_at<=q.recognized_at
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients unique_recipient WHERE unique_recipient.payout_id=b.id AND unique_recipient.user_id=r.user_id)=1
   AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric AND r.amount>0 AND r.amount=round(r.amount,2)
   AND r.amount::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions t WHERE t.transaction_type='bbj_payout' AND t.table_id=b.table_id
     AND t.to_user_id=r.user_id AND t.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND t.amount=r.amount AND t.created_at=w.created_at)=1
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger bank WHERE bank.status='posted' AND bank.category='bbj_payout'
     AND bank.from_type='bbj_pool' AND bank.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND bank.to_type='table_stack' AND bank.to_entity_id=b.table_id
     AND bank.amount=b.total_amount AND bank.idempotency_key=CASE WHEN b.kind='mini' THEN 'bbj_mini:'||b.pool_id::text||':'||b.table_id::text||':'||b.hand_number::text ELSE 'bbj_payout:'||b.id::text END)=1
   AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients p WHERE p.payout_id=b.id)
      +(SELECT coalesce(sum(u.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.paid_at IS NULL)=b.total_amount
   AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id)
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id AND u.amount=r.amount
       AND u.pool_id=b.pool_id AND u.table_id=b.table_id AND u.paid_at=w.created_at
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger parked WHERE parked.status='posted' AND parked.category='bbj_payout'
         AND parked.from_type='table_stack' AND parked.from_entity_id=b.table_id AND parked.to_type='bbj_pool' AND parked.to_entity_id=b.pool_id
         AND parked.amount=r.amount AND parked.idempotency_key='bbj_park:bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger redeemed WHERE redeemed.status='posted' AND redeemed.category='bbj_payout'
         AND redeemed.from_type='bbj_pool' AND redeemed.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND redeemed.to_type='table_stack' AND redeemed.to_entity_id=b.table_id
         AND redeemed.amount=r.amount AND redeemed.idempotency_key='bbj_redeem:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1)=1)
 ), matched AS (
  SELECT q.*,gift.proof treasury_gift,returned.proof treasury_return,f.id cash_funding_id,f.funding_club_id cash_club,f.user_id cash_user,f.amount cash_amount,
   e.id entry_id,e.funding_club_id entry_club,e.user_id entry_user,e.amount entry_amount,
   c.ledger_id credit_id,c.credited_club_id credit_club,c.user_id credit_user,c.amount credit_amount,
   ret.owners,ret.funding_club_id return_club,ret.user_id return_user,mv.moved_club,mv.moved_user,
   COALESCE(rf.refunds,0) refunds,rf.club refund_club,rf.player refund_user,te.refund_ent,te.refund_ent_user,te.refund_ent_club,late.n late_count,late.club late_club,late.player late_user,late.delta late_delta,j.club_id bbj_club,j.user_id bbj_user,j.payout_id bbj_payout
  FROM originals q
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT smarter_private.original_treasury_gift_evidence(q.ledger_id) proof
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='horse_funding'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='club_treasury' AND q.l->>'to_type'='table_stack') gift ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT smarter_private.original_treasury_return_evidence(q.ledger_id) proof
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet') returned ON true
  LEFT JOIN bbj_wallet_matches j ON j.ledger_id=q.ledger_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*) n,min(p.club_id::text)::uuid club,min(p.user_id::text)::uuid player,min(p.delta) delta
   FROM (SELECT q.ledger_id WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL
    AND q.l->>'category'='settlement' AND q.l->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%' OFFSET 0) eligible
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(eligible.ledger_id) p
  ) late ON true
  -- One-time filter (20261001): a probe only for the flows that can match.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.* FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND f.source_ledger_id=q.ledger_id OFFSET 0) f ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.* FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts e
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND e.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND e.asset='chips' AND q.tournament_id=e.tournament_id OFFSET 0) e ON true
  -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(q.tournament_id,NULL,p_start,p_end) for
  -- this flow's ledger only: its two branches verbatim, keyed by the ledger.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT c.ledger_id,c.tournament_id,c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount
   FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND c.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND c.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
   UNION ALL
   SELECT t.credit_ledger_id,t.tournament_id,t.user_id,t.source_wallet_club_id,t.amount_paid_now
   FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches t
   JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=t.entitlement_id
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=t.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c2 WHERE c2.ledger_id=t.credit_ledger_id)
  ) c ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.user_id)) owners,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid funding_club_id,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid user_id
   FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id')::uuid END occupancy_id
    FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
    WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=((q.l->>'table_id')::uuid)::text
    UNION
    SELECT original.occupancy_id FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a
     JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
     WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
   ) original_occupancies
   JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.occupancy_id=original_occupancies.occupancy_id
   WHERE r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid AND smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)
    AND q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND ((r.account_type=q.l->>'to_type' AND r.account_entity_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid) OR (r.operation_kind='horse_funding' AND r.account_type='club_treasury' AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid AND smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)))
    AND r.funding_club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id'=r.occupancy_id::text
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=r.table_id::text)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
       WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND original.occupancy_id=r.occupancy_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric))
  ) ret ON true
  -- A seat cashed out after it arrived by a table move holds chips whose
  -- original buy-in is on the source occupancy, not this one. The occupancy
  -- the cash-out vacated (its seat row in the same original transaction,
  -- carrying exactly the cashed-out stack) is traced through its move receipts
  -- by fn_cash_original_funding_lineage, the proof the boundaries and hands
  -- already use; the owner is its one original buy-in's club and player.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.club END moved_club,
    CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.player END moved_user
   FROM (SELECT min(i.before_row::text)::jsonb seat,count(*) n FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
     WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
      AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
      AND i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats' AND i.before_row->>'table_id'=q.l->>'table_id'
      AND i.before_row->>'user_id'=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND i.before_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb
      AND i.after_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL) s
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s.seat->>'user_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'table_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'id')::uuid,
     (s.seat->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,q.recognized_at,false) v) lin
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)) buyins,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,
     count(DISTINCT r.user_id) users,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid player
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(lin.v->'funding_receipts') ref JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid) own
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    AND s.n=1 AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s.seat->'stack') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) mv ON true
  -- A pending add-on returned unapplied is a refund of this player's own
  -- escrowed chips. Its wallet credit can carry no refund category: it runs
  -- inside the hand's post-commit obligations, after atomic_distribute_rake
  -- has declared that transaction's ledger context, so the audit labels it
  -- player_funding under the rake settlement. The application receipt
  -- written in the same transaction proves it: exactly one refund of this
  -- amount from a funding receipt of this player, club and table.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT r.refunds,r.club,r.player FROM rf_original_matches r
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
    AND r.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid
    AND r.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) rf ON true
  -- A seat won in a satellite and later refunded by the target tournament
  -- (cancelled, or the seat released) pays the seat's value back to the
  -- player's wallet from the target's prize liability. That seat was never a
  -- wallet-funded entry of the target, so no tournament credit receipt exists
  -- for it; its proof is the refund entitlement the payout is keyed by: same
  -- tournament, player, wallet club and gross, and the seat's owning club as
  -- resolved from its satellite registration.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT t.id refund_ent,t.user_id refund_ent_user,t.refund_wallet_club_id refund_ent_club
   FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements t
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='tourney:'||t.tournament_id::text||':refund-entitlement:'||t.id::text
    AND t.entitlement_kind IN('satellite_seat','wallet_charge','tournament_ticket') AND t.gross=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
    AND t.user_id::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND t.refund_wallet_club_id::text=q.l->>'club_id'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='refund'
    AND CASE t.entitlement_kind
     WHEN 'satellite_seat' THEN public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,NULL)=t.refund_wallet_club_id
     -- A pre-capture wallet entry refunded by cancellation (20261006154000):
     -- its entitlement's source ledger is the entry proven at the opening
     -- boundary of the refund's own week, for this exact registration, club
     -- and gross.
     WHEN 'wallet_charge' THEN t.source_ledger_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions r
       WHERE r.boundary=public.fn_union_week_start(q.recognized_at) AND r.union_id=p_union_id AND r.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND r.user_id=t.user_id
        AND r.owning_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id AND r.entries=1 AND r.entry_amount=t.gross AND r.returned=0
        AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
        AND r.proof->'entry_ledger' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('ledger_id',t.source_ledger_id::text)))=1
     WHEN 'tournament_ticket' THEN t.charge_category='tournament_ticket'
      AND t.evidence_kind='atomic_tournament_ticket' AND t.escrow_bucket='ticket_gross'
      AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=t.tournament_id::text
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets replacement WHERE replacement.source_refund_entitlement_id=t.id)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements duplicate WHERE duplicate.source_ticket_id=t.source_ticket_id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr
       WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id AND tr.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND tr.transaction_id=q.transaction_id
        AND tr.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tr.user_id=t.user_id AND tr.source_wallet_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tr.idempotency_key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND tr.amount_paid_before=0 AND tr.amount_paid_now=t.gross
        AND tr.refund_prize=t.refund_prize AND tr.refund_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tr.refund_fee=t.refund_fee)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_tickets tk
       JOIN public.chip_ledger admission ON admission.id=t.source_ledger_id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.ticket_id=tk.id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements h ON h.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
       JOIN public.tournament_payouts p ON p.id=a.payout_id
       JOIN public.chip_ledger issue ON issue.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key||':ticket_escrow'
       WHERE tk.id=t.source_ticket_id AND tk.holder_id=t.user_id AND tk.club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tk.status='redeemed' AND tk.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND tk.cancelled_at IS NULL
        AND tk.value=t.gross AND tk.entry_prize=t.refund_prize AND tk.entry_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tk.entry_fee=t.refund_fee
        AND t.gross=t.refund_prize+t.refund_bounty+t.refund_fee
        AND tk.source_tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tk.source_satellite_id=t.source_satellite_id
        -- Only the original direct award is admitted here. A replacement
        -- ticket still requires its distinct original refund disposition.
        AND tk.source_refund_entitlement_id IS NULL
        AND a.tournament_id=tk.source_satellite_id AND a.place=tk.source_satellite_award_place
        AND a.user_id=t.user_id AND a.delivery_kind='ticket' AND a.amount=t.gross AND a.payout_source='satellite_ticket'
        AND p.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND p.user_id=a.user_id AND p.amount=a.amount
        AND p.source=a.payout_source AND p.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key
        AND (p.position=a.place OR h.receipt_version>=3)
        AND h.target_id=t.tournament_id AND h.ticket_cost=t.gross
        AND h.target_buy_in=tk.entry_prize+tk.entry_bounty AND h.target_fee=tk.entry_fee
        AND issue.status='posted' AND issue.category='ticket_issue' AND issue.amount=t.gross
        AND issue.club_id=tk.club_id AND issue.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.from_type='prize_liability' AND issue.from_entity_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.to_type='escrow' AND issue.to_entity_id=tk.id
        AND issue.metadata->>'kind'='direct_satellite_entry_ticket'
        AND issue.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND issue.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'satellite_target_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND COALESCE(issue.metadata->>'position',issue.metadata->>'award_slot')=a.place::text
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_credit_idempotency w WHERE w.key=a.idempotency_key)
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions x
          WHERE x.transaction_type='tournament_ticket_issue' AND x.club_id=tk.club_id
           AND x.from_user_id IS NULL AND x.to_user_id=t.user_id AND x.amount=t.gross
           AND x.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND x.metadata->>'ledger_id'=issue.id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text AND x.metadata->>'idempotency_key'=a.idempotency_key
           AND x.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=a.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_award_place'=a.place::text)=1
        AND admission.status='posted' AND admission.category='ticket_redeem' AND admission.amount=t.gross
        AND admission.club_id=tk.club_id AND admission.tournament_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.from_type='escrow' AND admission.from_entity_id=tk.id
        AND admission.to_type='prize_liability' AND admission.to_entity_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.idempotency_key='ticket:'||tk.id::text||':tournament:'||t.tournament_id::text||':entry'
        AND admission.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND admission.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND admission.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'registration_id'=t.registration_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=t.source_satellite_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_prize'=to_jsonb(t.refund_prize)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_bounty'=to_jsonb(t.refund_bounty)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_fee'=to_jsonb(t.refund_fee))=1
     ELSE false END
  ) te ON true
 ), projected AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN bbj_payout IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_return' WHEN late_count=1 THEN 'cash_late_settlement' WHEN treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN treasury_return->>'status'='proven' THEN 'cash_return' WHEN cash_funding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR refunds=1 THEN 'cash_return'
    WHEN entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_funding' WHEN credit_id IS NOT NULL OR refund_ent IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_return' ELSE 'unsupported' END k,
   COALESCE(bbj_club,late_club,(treasury_gift->>'earning_club')::uuid,(treasury_return->>'earning_club')::uuid,cash_club,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_club WHEN owners=1 THEN return_club ELSE refund_club END,entry_club,credit_club,refund_ent_club) owner_club,
   COALESCE(bbj_user,late_user,(treasury_gift->>'user_id')::uuid,(treasury_return->>'user_id')::uuid,cash_user,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_user WHEN owners=1 THEN return_user ELSE refund_user END,entry_user,credit_user,refund_ent_user) owner_user
  FROM matched
 ) SELECT ledger_id,owner_club,owner_user,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta<0 THEN -late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_funding','tournament_funding') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta>0 THEN late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_return','tournament_return') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,k,
  (l->>'status'='posted' AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(l->'amount')>0 AND owner_club IS NOT NULL AND owner_user IS NOT NULL
   AND (owner_club::text=l->>'club_id' OR (treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' AND treasury_gift->>'ledger_id'=ledger_id::text AND treasury_gift->>'sponsor_bank_club'=l->>'club_id' AND treasury_gift->>'earning_club'=owner_club::text)) AND game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND CASE k
    WHEN 'cash_late_settlement' THEN late_count=1 AND abs(late_delta)=(l->>'amount')::numeric
    WHEN 'cash_funding' THEN (cash_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' AND (treasury_gift->>'amount')::numeric=(l->>'amount')::numeric)) AND l->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND l->>'category' IN('buyin','rebuy','addon','horse_funding')
    WHEN 'cash_return' THEN ((treasury_return->>'status'='proven' AND (treasury_return->>'amount')::numeric=(l->>'amount')::numeric) OR bbj_payout IS NOT NULL OR owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR (refunds=1 AND l->>'category'='player_funding')) AND l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND (l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
     OR (l->>'category'='player_funding' AND refunds=1 AND refund_club=owner_club AND refund_user=owner_user)
     OR (l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND bbj_payout IS NOT NULL AND bbj_club=owner_club AND bbj_user=owner_user))
    WHEN 'tournament_funding' THEN entry_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon')
    WHEN 'tournament_return' THEN (credit_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (credit_id IS NULL AND refund_ent IS NOT NULL)) AND l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_prize','prize','bounty','refund','tournament_refund')
    ELSE false END) IS TRUE
 FROM projected
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM smarter_private.original_restoration_cash_returns(p_union_id,p_start,p_end)
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM smarter_private.original_erased_cash_discharge_returns(p_union_id,p_start,p_end);
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_touc.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_touch(h union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE o public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes;
BEGIN
 SELECT q.* INTO o FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes q WHERE q.table_id=h.table_id AND q.hand_number=h.hand_number;
 IF NOT FOUND OR o.recognized_at IS DISTINCT FROM h.recognized_at
  OR o.game_scope->>'game_union_id' IS DISTINCT FROM h.game_union_id
  OR o.evidence->>'accepted_rake' IS DISTINCT FROM h.accepted_rake
  OR public.fn_union_pnl_compact_participants(o.evidence->'participants') IS DISTINCT FROM h.participants THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'posthand_escrow_projection_touch_disagrees' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_participants(o);
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready(p_p.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready(p_projection text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.completed_at IS NOT NULL FROM public.union_pnl_projection_build b WHERE b.projection=p_projection),false)
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlemen.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(p_ledger_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(club_id uuid, user_id uuid, delta numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH original AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.* FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q
  JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=q.ledger_id AND to_jsonb(l)=q.ledger_snapshot
  JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames frame ON frame.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND frame.observed_at=q.recognized_at
  WHERE q.ledger_id=p_ledger_id AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'category'='settlement' AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'row_hash' IS NOT NULL
   AND q.game_scope ?& ARRAY['host_club_id','game_union_id','asset','unit_scale','is_private','tournament_id']
   AND jsonb_typeof(q.game_scope->'is_private')='boolean'
   AND q.game_scope->'tournament_id'='null'::jsonb
   AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%'
 ), linked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,s.id settlement_id,s.hand_id legacy_id,s.totals,
   a.*,o.evidence,o.game_scope outcome_scope,
   live.hand_id live_hand_id,live.payload_hash live_payload_hash,live.stack_result live_stack_result,
   live.post_commit_completed_at live_completed_at,live.post_commit_result live_postcommit,
   cert.history_hand_id retained_hand_id,cert.manifest_id retained_manifest,cert.settled_at retained_completed_at,cert.hand_number retained_number,
   cert.original_result_sha256 retained_result_sha,cert.original_request_sha256 retained_stack_request_sha,cert.accounting_evidence_sha256 retained_evidence_sha,
   v.accepted_request,v.participants original_participants,v.stack_claim,v.stack_settlement,v.manifest_id original_manifest,v.accepted_at original_accepted_at,
   smarter_private.horse_settlement_original_result(k.table_id,k.hand_id,k.result) claim_result,k.status claim_status
  FROM original q
  JOIN public.ca_settlements s ON s.id=(q.ledger_snapshot->>'settlement_id')::uuid
   AND s.table_id=(q.ledger_snapshot->>'table_id')::uuid
   AND s.settlement_type='hand_stacks' AND s.state='final' AND s.tournament_id IS NULL
  JOIN public.settlement_idempotency_keys k ON k.table_id=s.table_id AND k.hand_id=s.hand_id
  JOIN public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts v ON v.table_id=s.table_id AND v.hand_number=(k.result->>'hand_number')::bigint
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.hand_atomic_commits,v.atomic_receipt) a
  LEFT JOIN public.hand_atomic_commits live ON live.table_id=a.table_id AND live.hand_number=a.hand_number
  LEFT JOIN smarter_private.horse_settlement_key_certificates cert ON cert.table_id=s.table_id AND cert.stack_hand_id=s.hand_id
  JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=a.table_id AND o.hand_number=a.hand_number
   AND o.hand_id=a.hand_id AND o.payload_hash=a.payload_hash AND public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_accepted(o)
  WHERE q.game_scope=o.game_scope AND v.game_scope=o.game_scope
   AND v.hand_id=a.hand_id AND v.payload_hash=a.payload_hash AND v.table_id=a.table_id AND v.hand_number=a.hand_number
   AND s.hand_id=md5('ca-hand:'||s.table_id::text||':'||a.hand_number::text||
    CASE WHEN s.totals->>'ref' IS NULL OR s.totals->>'ref'='' THEN '' ELSE ':'||(s.totals->>'ref') END)::uuid
   AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'idempotency_key'='late_seat_settle:'||s.hand_id::text||':'||
    CASE WHEN q.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='player_wallet' THEN q.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id'
      ELSE q.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id' END
 ), witnessed AS (
  SELECT a.*,d.v departed,p.v participant,r.v signed_request,own.v owner,
   public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(d.v->'delta') signed_delta,
   public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(a.ledger_snapshot->'amount') amount
  FROM linked a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.stack_result->'departed') x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=CASE WHEN a.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='player_wallet' THEN a.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id' ELSE a.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id' END) d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.original_participants) x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=d.v->>'user_id') p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.accepted_request->'stacks') x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=d.v->>'user_id') r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.evidence->'participants') x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=d.v->>'user_id') own
 )
 SELECT (w.departed->>'club_id')::uuid,(w.departed->>'user_id')::uuid,w.signed_delta
 FROM witnessed w
 JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency credit ON credit.key=w.ledger_snapshot->>'idempotency_key'
  AND credit.user_id=(w.departed->>'user_id')::uuid AND credit.amount=w.signed_delta
 WHERE w.claim_status='succeeded' AND w.claim_result=w.stack_result
  AND w.stack_claim->'result'=w.stack_result AND w.stack_settlement->'totals'=w.totals
  AND w.totals->'departed'=w.stack_result->'departed'
  AND w.stack_result->'success'='true'::jsonb AND w.stack_result->'conservation_checked'='true'::jsonb
  AND w.accepted_request->>'table_id'=w.table_id::text
  AND w.accepted_request->>'hand_number'=w.hand_number::text
  AND public.fn_cash_signed_retained_request_matches(w.table_id,w.hand_number,w.payload_hash,w.accepted_request)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.stack_result#>'{request,stacks}') refs(v)
   WHERE refs.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id' AND refs.v->>'seat_id'=w.departed->>'seat_id'
    AND refs.v->>'seat_joined_at'=w.departed->>'seat_joined_at'
    AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(refs.v->'stack')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after')
    AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(refs.v->'stack_before')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before'))=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.stack_result->'departed') q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.original_participants) q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.accepted_request->'stacks') q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.evidence->'participants') q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids'))=
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT v) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(v))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.original_participants) q(v)
   WHERE public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_before') IS NULL OR public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_after') IS NULL
    OR public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'poker_delta') IS DISTINCT FROM
       public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_after')-public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_before'))
  AND (SELECT sum(public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'poker_delta')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.original_participants) q(v))
      +public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.accepted_request->'rake')+public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.accepted_request->'bbj')
      =public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.accepted_request->'inflow')
  AND CASE WHEN w.live_hand_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   w.live_hand_id=w.hand_id AND w.live_payload_hash=w.payload_hash AND w.live_stack_result=w.stack_result
   AND w.live_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(w.live_completed_at) AND w.live_postcommit->'ok'='true'::jsonb
  ELSE w.retained_hand_id=w.hand_id AND w.retained_manifest=w.original_manifest
   AND w.retained_number=w.hand_number AND w.retained_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(w.retained_completed_at)
   AND w.retained_completed_at>=w.original_accepted_at AND w.retained_completed_at>=w.committed_at
   -- These digests name the full retained monetary original in provenance,
   -- never the compact key's JSON or a reconstructed expired raw hand.
   AND w.retained_result_sha=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(w.stack_result::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   AND w.retained_stack_request_sha=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((w.stack_result->'request')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   AND w.retained_evidence_sha=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((w.evidence-'accepted_bbj'-'accepted_rake'-'accepted_external_net')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') END
  AND w.amount>0 AND w.signed_delta<>0 AND abs(w.signed_delta)=w.amount
  AND public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((w.participant->>'user_id')::uuid,w.table_id,
    (w.participant->>'seat_id')::uuid,(w.participant->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,
    (w.participant->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz,(w.participant#>>'{funding_lineage,observed_at}')::timestamptz,false)
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.participant->'funding_lineage'
  AND w.participant#>'{funding_lineage,issues}'='[]'::jsonb
  AND (SELECT array_agg(refs.v->>'id' ORDER BY refs.v->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.participant#>'{funding_lineage,funding_receipts}') refs(v))
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(refs.v ORDER BY refs.v) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(v))
  AND w.participant->>'seat_id'=w.departed->>'seat_id'
  AND w.participant->>'seat_joined_at'=w.departed->>'seat_joined_at'
  AND w.signed_request->>'seat_id'=w.departed->>'seat_id'
  AND w.signed_request->>'seat_joined_at'=w.departed->>'seat_joined_at'
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before') IS NOT NULL
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after') IS NOT NULL
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after')-public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before')=w.signed_delta
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.signed_request->'stack_before')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before')
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.signed_request->'stack')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after')
  AND w.owner->'ownership_certified'='true'::jsonb
  AND w.owner->>'earning_club_id'=w.departed->>'club_id'
  AND w.owner->>'earning_club_id'=w.ledger_snapshot->>'club_id'
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.owner->'observed_stack_delta')=w.signed_delta
  AND jsonb_array_length(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids')>0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(receipt_id)
    JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=refs.receipt_id::uuid WHERE f.operation_kind='buyin')=1
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(receipt_id)
   LEFT JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=refs.receipt_id::uuid
   LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=f.source_ledger_id
   WHERE f.id IS NULL OR f.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM (w.departed->>'user_id')::uuid
    OR f.funding_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM (w.departed->>'club_id')::uuid
    OR f.funding_union_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM w.game_scope->>'game_union_id'
    OR f.account_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR f.account_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.user_id
    OR f.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR f.unit_scale IS DISTINCT FROM 2
    OR f.amount<=0 OR f.amount IS NULL OR f.amount<>round(f.amount,2) OR f.amount::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    OR f.balance_before-f.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount
    OR l.id IS NULL OR l.row_hash IS NULL OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount
    OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.funding_club_id OR l.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM f.account_type
    OR l.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.user_id OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_stack'
    OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.table_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM f.operation_kind)
  AND CASE WHEN w.signed_delta>0 THEN
   w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id'=w.table_id::text
   AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id'=w.departed->>'user_id'
  ELSE w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_type'='player_wallet' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id'=w.departed->>'user_id'
   AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id'=w.table_id::text END;
EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '55000' THEN
 IF SQLERRM='HORSE_SETTLEMENT_COMPACT_ORIGINAL_CONFLICT' THEN RETURN;END IF;RAISE;
WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_parameter_value THEN
 RETURN;
END
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(p_registration_id uuid, p_tournament_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH reg AS (
  SELECT e.after_row r FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.source_name='tournament_players' AND e.row_id=p_registration_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1
 ), who AS (
  SELECT (r->>'user_id')::uuid user_id,(r->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid satellite_id,(r->>'registered_at')::timestamptz registered_at,
   (r->>'tournament_id')::uuid target_id,(r->>'club_id')::uuid admission_club_id
  FROM reg WHERE (p_tournament_id IS NULL OR r->>'tournament_id'=p_tournament_id::text)
   AND r->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL AND r->>'user_id' IS NOT NULL AND r->>'tournament_id' IS NOT NULL
 ), award AS (
  SELECT a.tournament_id,a.user_id FROM who w
  JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.tournament_id=w.satellite_id AND a.user_id=w.user_id
  JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements s ON s.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
  WHERE (a.delivery_kind='seat' AND a.registration_id=p_registration_id AND s.target_id=w.target_id)
   OR (a.delivery_kind='ticket' AND a.registration_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets t
    WHERE t.id=a.ticket_id AND t.holder_id=w.user_id AND t.source_satellite_id=w.satellite_id
     AND t.status='redeemed' AND t.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND t.redeemed_at=w.registered_at
     AND CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_payouts p
       WHERE p.tournament_id=t.source_satellite_id AND p.source='satellite_ticket'
        AND p.metadata->>'ticket_id'=t.id::text AND p.metadata->>'ticket_contract'='same_value_entry_v1')
     THEN
      -- Original target remains issuance provenance. A value ticket is consumed
      -- by its one canonical atomic admission into the actual registration.
      public.fn_ca_assert_satellite_value_ticket(t.id)='chips'
      AND t.source_tournament_id=s.target_id
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments target
       WHERE target.id=w.target_id AND w.admission_club_id=t.club_id
        AND (target.union_id IS NOT NULL OR target.club_id=t.club_id)
        AND public.fn_poker_diamond_tournament(target.id) IS FALSE
        AND round(COALESCE(target.buy_in_amount,0),2)+round(COALESCE(target.buy_in_fee,0),2)=t.value)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements e
       JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=e.source_ledger_id
       JOIN public.tournaments target ON target.id=e.tournament_id
       CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_tournament_entry_split(target.buy_in_amount,target.buy_in_fee,target.bounty_amount,
        COALESCE(target.is_bounty,false) OR COALESCE(target.is_pko,false) OR COALESCE(target.is_mystery_bounty,false)) split
       WHERE e.source_ticket_id=t.id AND e.tournament_id=w.target_id AND e.registration_id=p_registration_id
        AND e.user_id=w.user_id AND e.source_satellite_id=w.satellite_id
        AND e.entitlement_kind='tournament_ticket' AND e.charge_category='tournament_ticket'
        AND e.evidence_kind='atomic_tournament_ticket' AND e.escrow_bucket='ticket_gross'
        AND e.refund_wallet_club_id=t.club_id AND e.gross=t.value
        AND e.refund_prize>=0 AND e.refund_bounty>=0 AND e.refund_fee>=0
        AND e.refund_prize=split.prize AND e.refund_bounty=split.bounty AND e.refund_fee=split.rake AND split.charge=t.value
        AND round(e.refund_prize+e.refund_bounty+e.refund_fee,2)=t.value
        AND e.created_at=w.registered_at
        AND l.idempotency_key='ticket:'||t.id::text||':tournament:'||w.target_id::text||':entry'
        AND l.status='posted' AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL AND l.category='ticket_redeem'
        AND l.from_type='escrow' AND l.from_entity_id=t.id
        AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=w.target_id
        AND l.tournament_id=w.target_id AND l.club_id=t.club_id AND l.amount=t.value
        AND l.created_at=w.registered_at
        AND l.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND l.metadata->>'ticket_id'=t.id::text AND l.metadata->>'user_id'=w.user_id::text
        AND l.metadata->>'registration_id'=p_registration_id::text
        AND l.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=s.target_id::text
        AND l.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=w.satellite_id::text
        AND (l.metadata->>'entry_prize')::numeric=e.refund_prize
        AND (l.metadata->>'entry_bounty')::numeric=e.refund_bounty
        AND (l.metadata->>'entry_fee')::numeric=e.refund_fee
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions x
         WHERE x.transaction_type='tournament_ticket_entry' AND x.club_id=t.club_id
          AND x.from_user_id=w.user_id AND x.to_user_id IS NULL AND x.amount=t.value
          AND x.metadata->>'ticket_id'=t.id::text AND x.metadata->>'registration_id'=p_registration_id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'holder_id'=w.user_id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'target_tournament_id'=w.target_id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'entitlement_id'=e.id::text AND x.metadata->>'ledger_id'=l.id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'idempotency_key'=l.idempotency_key
          AND x.metadata->>'wallet_chips_credited'='0')=1)=1
     ELSE s.target_id=w.target_id AND t.source_tournament_id=w.target_id END))
 ), entry AS (
  SELECT count(*) n,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation='entry') entries,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR r.amount IS NULL OR r.amount<=0 OR r.funding_club_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT row.* FROM public.chip_ledger row WHERE row.id=r.ledger_id OFFSET 0) l WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.from_type='player_wallet' AND l.from_entity_id=r.user_id
     AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=r.tournament_id AND l.tournament_id=r.tournament_id AND l.amount=r.amount
     AND l.club_id=r.funding_club_id AND l.category IN ('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon') AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL)) bad
  FROM award a JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND r.user_id=a.user_id
 )
 SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM award)=1 AND e.n>0 AND e.entries>=1 AND e.clubs=1 AND e.bad=0 THEN e.club END FROM entry e
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_touched_registration.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_touched_registrations(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_projected boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(registration_id uuid, touched_tournament_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT i.row_id,i.tournament_id FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_touches i
 WHERE p_projected IS TRUE AND i.source_name OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'tournament_players'::pg_catalog.text
 AND i.frame_observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.>=) p_start AND i.frame_observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<) p_end
 AND i.observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.>=) p_start AND i.observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<) p_end
 UNION ALL
 SELECT i.row_id,COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row) OPERATOR(pg_catalog.->>) 'tournament_id'::pg_catalog.text
 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) i.transaction_id
 WHERE p_projected IS NOT TRUE AND i.source_name OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'tournament_players'::pg_catalog.text
 AND b.observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.>=) p_start AND b.observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<) p_end
 AND i.observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.>=) p_start AND i.observed_at OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<) p_end
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_tournament_entry_clu.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_tournament_entry_club_of(p_asset text, p_amount numeric, p_funding_club_id uuid, p_ledger_id uuid, p_entitlement_id uuid, p_registration_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_asset OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'chips'::pg_catalog.text AND p_amount OPERATOR(pg_catalog.>) 0::pg_catalog.numeric THEN p_funding_club_id
 WHEN p_asset OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'chips'::pg_catalog.text AND p_amount OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 0::pg_catalog.numeric
 AND p_ledger_id IS NULL AND p_entitlement_id IS NULL
 AND (p_registration_snapshot OPERATOR(pg_catalog.->>) 'source_satellite_id'::pg_catalog.text) IS NULL
 AND (p_registration_snapshot OPERATOR(pg_catalog.->) 'is_satellite_qualifier'::pg_catalog.text) OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'false'::pg_catalog.jsonb
 THEN (p_registration_snapshot OPERATOR(pg_catalog.->>) 'club_id'::pg_catalog.text)::pg_catalog.uuid END;
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_week_bbj_stack_award.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_week_bbj_stack_awards(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(club_id uuid, user_id uuid, amount numeric, payout_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
 FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients rr JOIN public.bbj_payouts bp ON bp.id=rr.payout_id
 JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency wi ON wi.key='bbj:'||bp.id::text||':'||rr.user_id::text
 JOIN public.chip_ledger cl ON cl.idempotency_key=wi.key
 JOIN public.union_pnl_original_flows q ON q.ledger_id=cl.id
 WHERE rr.created_at>=p_start AND rr.created_at<p_end AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
  AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
 ), bbj_wallet_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.ledger_id,(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,r.user_id,r.amount,b.id payout_id
  FROM originals q
  JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=CASE WHEN q.l->>'idempotency_key' ~ '^bbj:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN split_part(q.l->>'idempotency_key',':',2)::uuid END
  JOIN public.bbj_payout_recipients r ON r.payout_id=b.id AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
  JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency w ON w.key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND w.user_id=r.user_id AND w.amount=r.amount
  JOIN public.bbj_pools pool ON pool.id=b.pool_id
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND q.l->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
   AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=b.table_id::text AND q.l->>'table_id'=b.table_id::text
   AND q.l->>'id'=q.ledger_id::text AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text
   AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND (pool.union_id=p_union_id OR (pool.union_id IS NULL AND pool.club_id::text=q.game_scope->>'host_club_id'))
   AND b.kind IN('main','mini') AND b.total_amount>0 AND b.total_amount=round(b.total_amount,2)
   AND b.created_at<=q.recognized_at AND r.created_at=w.created_at AND w.created_at>=b.created_at AND w.created_at<=q.recognized_at
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients unique_recipient WHERE unique_recipient.payout_id=b.id AND unique_recipient.user_id=r.user_id)=1
   AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric AND r.amount>0 AND r.amount=round(r.amount,2)
   AND r.amount::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions t WHERE t.transaction_type='bbj_payout' AND t.table_id=b.table_id
     AND t.to_user_id=r.user_id AND t.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND t.amount=r.amount AND t.created_at=w.created_at)=1
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger bank WHERE bank.status='posted' AND bank.category='bbj_payout'
     AND bank.from_type='bbj_pool' AND bank.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND bank.to_type='table_stack' AND bank.to_entity_id=b.table_id
     AND bank.amount=b.total_amount AND bank.idempotency_key=CASE WHEN b.kind='mini' THEN 'bbj_mini:'||b.pool_id::text||':'||b.table_id::text||':'||b.hand_number::text ELSE 'bbj_payout:'||b.id::text END)=1
   AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients p WHERE p.payout_id=b.id)
      +(SELECT coalesce(sum(u.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.paid_at IS NULL)=b.total_amount
   AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id)
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id AND u.amount=r.amount
       AND u.pool_id=b.pool_id AND u.table_id=b.table_id AND u.paid_at=w.created_at
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger parked WHERE parked.status='posted' AND parked.category='bbj_payout'
         AND parked.from_type='table_stack' AND parked.from_entity_id=b.table_id AND parked.to_type='bbj_pool' AND parked.to_entity_id=b.pool_id
         AND parked.amount=r.amount AND parked.idempotency_key='bbj_park:bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger redeemed WHERE redeemed.status='posted' AND redeemed.category='bbj_payout'
         AND redeemed.from_type='bbj_pool' AND redeemed.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND redeemed.to_type='table_stack' AND redeemed.to_entity_id=b.table_id
         AND redeemed.amount=r.amount AND redeemed.idempotency_key='bbj_redeem:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1)=1)
 )
 SELECT (pp.p->>'earning_club_id')::uuid, r.user_id, r.amount, r.payout_id
 FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients r
 JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=r.payout_id
 JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=b.table_id AND o.hand_number=b.hand_number
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(o.evidence->'participants','[]')) p
  WHERE p->>'user_id'=r.user_id::text LIMIT 1) pp
 WHERE r.created_at>=p_start AND r.created_at<p_end AND r.amount>0
  AND o.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
  -- a share paid to the wallet of a departed recipient never reached the felt
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_credit_idempotency w
   WHERE w.key='bbj:'||r.payout_id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.chip_ledger wallet_leg WHERE wallet_leg.idempotency_key='bbj:'||r.payout_id::text||':'||r.user_id::text AND wallet_leg.to_type='player_wallet')
 UNION ALL SELECT j.club_id,j.user_id,j.amount,j.payout_id FROM bbj_wallet_matches j
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_week_hand_lines(p_un.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_week_hand_lines(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_projected boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(hand_accepted_rake text, hand_participants jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_projected THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT h.accepted_rake,
   CASE WHEN h.shaped AND cert.hand_number IS NOT NULL THEN public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_touch(h) ELSE COALESCE(gift.evidence->'participants',h.participants) END
   FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches h
   LEFT JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes original ON original.table_id=h.table_id AND original.hand_number=h.hand_number
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN original.evidence->>'status'='blocked' AND original.recognized_at=h.recognized_at AND original.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=h.game_union_id AND original.evidence->>'accepted_rake'=h.accepted_rake AND public.fn_union_pnl_compact_participants(original.evidence->'participants')=h.participants THEN smarter_private.original_treasury_cash_outcome_evidence(to_jsonb(original)) END evidence) gift ON true
   LEFT JOIN smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates cert ON (cert.table_id,cert.hand_number)=(h.table_id,h.hand_number)
   WHERE h.game_union_id=p_union_id::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end;
 ELSE
  RETURN QUERY SELECT COALESCE(gift.evidence,o.evidence)->>'accepted_rake',
   CASE WHEN cert.hand_number IS NOT NULL THEN public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_participants(o) ELSE COALESCE(gift.evidence,o.evidence)->'participants' END
   FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN o.evidence->>'status'='blocked' THEN smarter_private.original_treasury_cash_outcome_evidence(to_jsonb(o)) END evidence) gift
   LEFT JOIN smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates cert ON (cert.table_id,cert.hand_number)=(o.table_id,o.hand_number)
   WHERE o.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND o.recognized_at>=p_start AND o.recognized_at<p_end;
 END IF;
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_week_rake_straddle(p.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_week_rake_straddle(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN o.recognized_at < p_start THEN -s.rake_credit ELSE s.rake_credit END), 0)
    FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s
    JOIN public.rake_records r ON r.id = s.rake_record_id
    JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.hand_id = r.hand_id
   WHERE s.source_type = 'cash_rake_accrual'
     AND s.union_id = p_union_id
     -- The same accepted population the report reads: this union's own
     -- outcomes, and linked (Lightning) outcomes through their resolutions.
     AND (o.game_scope->>'game_union_id' = p_union_id::text
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions l
                      WHERE l.table_id = o.table_id AND l.hand_number = o.hand_number
                        AND l.hand_id = o.hand_id
                        AND l.game_scope->>'game_union_id' = p_union_id::text))
     AND ((s.earned_at >= p_end AND s.earned_at < p_end + interval '10 minutes'
           AND o.recognized_at >= p_start AND o.recognized_at < p_end)
       OR (s.earned_at >= p_start AND s.earned_at < p_start + interval '10 minutes'
           AND o.recognized_at < p_start AND o.recognized_at >= p_start - interval '10 minutes'))
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_week_shaped_hands(p_.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_week_shaped_hands(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_projected boolean)
 RETURNS SETOF union_pnl_cash_outcomes
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_projected THEN
  RETURN QUERY WITH touch_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT h.table_id,h.hand_number FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches h WHERE h.game_union_id=p_union_id::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end AND h.shaped IS TRUE) SELECT o.* FROM touch_keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT q.* FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes q WHERE q.table_id=k.table_id AND q.hand_number=k.hand_number AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end AND (q.evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR q.evidence->'basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
     OR q.evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR q.evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM q.game_scope) OFFSET 0)o;
 ELSE
  RETURN QUERY SELECT o.* FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o WHERE o.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND o.recognized_at>=p_start AND o.recognized_at<p_end
   AND (o.evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR o.evidence->'basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
    OR o.evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR o.evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope);
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_totals_follow_club_counts()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r RECORD;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT DISTINCT uc.union_id
      FROM newrows n
      JOIN oldrows o ON o.id = n.id
      JOIN union_clubs uc ON uc.club_id = n.id
     WHERE COALESCE(n.member_count, 0)      IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(o.member_count, 0)
        OR COALESCE(n.admin_count, 0)       IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(o.admin_count, 0)
        OR COALESCE(n.super_agent_count, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(o.super_agent_count, 0)
        OR COALESCE(n.agent_count, 0)       IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(o.agent_count, 0)
  LOOP
    PERFORM public.recompute_union_levels(r.union_id, true);
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NULL;
END;

public.fn_unresolved_insurance_offers(p_.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_unresolved_insurance_offers(p_window interval DEFAULT '1 day'::interval)
 RETURNS TABLE(table_id uuid, hand_number integer, player_id uuid, offered bigint, resolved bigint, last_offer timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT e.table_id, e.hand_number, e.player_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'offered')                                   AS offered,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event IN ('accepted','declined','timeout','cashed_out')) AS resolved,
         MAX(e.created_at) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'offered')                          AS last_offer
  FROM public.insurance_offer_events e
  WHERE e.created_at > now() - p_window
  GROUP BY e.table_id, e.hand_number, e.player_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'offered')
       > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event IN ('accepted','declined','timeout','cashed_out'))
     AND MAX(e.created_at) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'offered') < now() - interval '3 minutes';
$function$

public.guard_agent_wallet_direct_update(.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_agent_wallet_direct_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if current_user in ('authenticated','anon') then
    if tg_op='INSERT' and (
      coalesce(new.agent_wallet_balance,0)<>0 or coalesce(new.business_balance,0)<>0 or
      coalesce(new.player_wallet_balance,0)<>0 or coalesce(new.player_balance,0)<>0 or
      coalesce(new.promo_wallet_balance,0)<>0 or coalesce(new.promo_balance,0)<>0 or
      coalesce(new.credit_limit,0)<>0 or coalesce(new.credit_used,0)<>0 or
      coalesce(new.commission_rate,0)<>0 or coalesce(new.player_rakeback_rate,0)<>0
    ) then
      raise exception 'Agent financial accounts may only be created through authorized operations';
    elsif tg_op='UPDATE' and (
      new.agent_wallet_balance is distinct from old.agent_wallet_balance or
      new.business_balance is distinct from old.business_balance or
      new.player_wallet_balance is distinct from old.player_wallet_balance or
      new.player_balance is distinct from old.player_balance or
      new.promo_wallet_balance is distinct from old.promo_wallet_balance or
      new.promo_balance is distinct from old.promo_balance or
      new.credit_limit is distinct from old.credit_limit or
      new.credit_used is distinct from old.credit_used or
      new.commission_rate is distinct from old.commission_rate or
      new.player_rakeback_rate is distinct from old.player_rakeback_rate
    ) then
      raise exception 'Agent financial accounts may only change through authorized operations';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$

public.guard_wallet_balance_write().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_wallet_balance_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_stack   TEXT;
  v_bypass  TEXT;
  v_allowed TEXT[] := ARRAY[
    'atomic_credit_wallet_and_log','atomic_deduct_wallet_and_log','atomic_wallet_transfer',
    'atomic_chip_transfer','fn_idempotent_credit_wallet','fn_idempotent_deduct_wallet',
    'fn_idempotent_wallet_transfer','atomic_table_buyin','atomic_table_cashout',
    'atomic_table_rebuy','atomic_table_addon','atomic_table_withdraw','atomic_seat_horse','player_leave_table','atomic_tournament_register',
    'atomic_tournament_unregister','atomic_cancel_tournament','distribute_tournament_prizes',
    'process_tournament_rebuy',
    'atomic_pay_player_rakeback','credit_agent_commission',
    'credit_player_rakeback','fn_cancel_cashout','fn_reject_cashout',
    'fn_clawback_chips_atomic','distribute_chips','mint_club_chips','add_chips','add_to_promo_wallet',
    'credit_player_wallet','deduct_player_wallet','wallet_internal_transfer','wallet_user_transfer',
    'create_user_wallets','reconcile_ledger_nightly',
    -- added 2026-08-15 with the chip-removal authority policy
    'fn_admin_remove_player_chips','fn_approve_cashout_atomic','fn_cancel_cashout_atomic',
    -- added 2026-08-21 with the diamond-backed Chip Mint (Dan's directive)
    'fn_mint_chips_from_diamonds',
    -- added 2026-08-23 with the Club Bank Cashier (Dan directive)
    'fn_club_bank_send',
    'fn_club_bank_claim_back', 'fn_promo_wallet_send',
    'fn_club_bank_reverse'
    -- removed 2026-08-31 (phase 6): execute_commission_payout, which credited a
    -- wallet, debited nothing and never marked the commission settled.
    -- removed 2026-09-01 (phase 7): atomic_pay_agent_settlement, a staff payout
    -- that decremented a column nothing incremented.
  ];
  v_fn TEXT;
BEGIN
  v_bypass := current_setting('app.bypass_wallet_guard', true);
  IF v_bypass = 'on' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_stack = PG_CONTEXT;
  FOREACH v_fn IN ARRAY v_allowed LOOP
    IF v_stack ~ ('function (public\.)?' || v_fn || '\(') THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RAISE EXCEPTION
    'Direct balance mutation on %.% is forbidden by Phase 4.1.6a guard. '
    'All balance changes must flow through the whitelisted SECURITY DEFINER '
    'RPCs (atomic_*, fn_idempotent_*, distribute_chips, mint_club_chips, etc.) '
    'that log to chip_ledger. Admin override: '
    'SELECT set_config(''app.bypass_wallet_guard'', ''on'', true);',
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TG_TABLE_NAME
    USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
END;
$function$

public.is_club_admin(p_club_id uuid).def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_club_admin(p_club_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.club_members m WHERE m.club_id=p_club_id
  AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.role IN ('owner','co_owner','admin')
  AND public.fn_cashier_member_is_active(m.club_id,m.user_id));
END $function$

public.is_club_admin(p_club_id uuid, p_u.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_club_admin(p_club_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clubs WHERE id=p_club_id AND asset='diamonds') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clubs WHERE id = p_club_id AND owner_id = p_user_id
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM club_members
        WHERE club_id = p_club_id
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND role IN ('owner', 'co_owner', 'admin')
        AND status = 'active'
    );
END;
$function$

public.reconcile_ledger_nightly().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_ledger_nightly()
 RETURNS TABLE(total_checked integer, ok_count integer, warn_count integer, critical_count integer, worst_drift numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '300s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_total   INT := 0;
  v_ok      INT := 0;
  v_warn    INT := 0;
  v_crit    INT := 0;
  v_worst   NUMERIC := 0;
  v_frozen  NUMERIC;
  v_now     NUMERIC;
  v_left    NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM public.ledger_reconcile_log WHERE run_date = CURRENT_DATE AND entity_type = ANY (public.fn_ca_reconcile_owned_entity_types());

  SELECT frozen_total INTO v_frozen
    FROM public.ca_frozen_pool_baseline WHERE pool = 'public.wallets';
  -- The frozen pool is the PRE-FREEZE rows. Post-freeze rows belong to
  -- certification accounts whose harness chips cycle through the no-club
  -- fallback and are deleted by the certification cleanup; they are not the
  -- stranded pool. And a pre-freeze row can LEAVE, because public.wallets
  -- cascades from profiles and auth.users - a deleted row is not a write, so
  -- recorded departures are added back before comparing. An attributable
  -- teardown nets to zero; an unrecorded change still pages. This is the same
  -- arithmetic fn_ca_quick_reconcile has used since 2026-09-02.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) INTO v_now FROM public.wallets
   WHERE created_at < '2026-08-22';
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deleted_balance), 0) INTO v_left
    FROM public.ca_frozen_pool_deletions WHERE pool = 'public.wallets';
  v_now := v_now + COALESCE(v_left, 0);
  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  VALUES (
    'frozen_wallets_pool', NULL, COALESCE(v_frozen, 0), v_now,
    CASE WHEN v_frozen IS NULL THEN 'critical'
         WHEN v_now = v_frozen  THEN 'ok'
         ELSE 'critical' END,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'reconcile_ledger_nightly',
      'rule', 'pool frozen 2026-08-21: any movement means a money path is writing to the dead pool',
      'baseline', v_frozen, 'observed', v_now));

  /* CLUB TREASURY, MEASURED FROM THE LINE (2026-08-31).
     The arithmetic lives in fn_ca_treasury_positions() (2026-09-21) so that
     the escalator can re-measure a stored finding with the SAME formula this
     records. Do not inline it again here: two copies of a tuned formula is
     how one of them silently stops matching. */
  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'club_treasury', p.club_id, p.ledger_balance, p.stored_balance, p.severity,
    jsonb_build_object('source', 'reconcile_ledger_nightly',
                       'unbaselined', p.unbaselined,
                       'note', CASE WHEN p.unbaselined
                         THEN 'no ca_treasury_baseline row for this club, so its opening balance is unknown and no drift is computed; trg_ca_club_gets_a_baseline writes one for every club created from 2026-09-08'
                         END,
                       'basis', 'ca_treasury_baseline + post-cutover chip_ledger flow',
                       'opening_balance', p.opening,
                       'credited_since', p.credited,
                       'debited_since', p.debited,
                       'cutover', p.cutover)
  FROM public.fn_ca_treasury_positions() p;

  -- INSURANCE + EV-CASHOUT BANK (2026-08-28)
  WITH led AS (
    SELECT bank_type, bank_entity_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(premium,0) - COALESCE(payout,0)) AS bal,
           COUNT(*) AS contracts
    FROM public.insurance_transactions
    WHERE bank_entity_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bank_type, bank_entity_id
  ),
  joined AS (
    SELECT l.bank_type, l.bank_entity_id, l.bal AS ledger_balance, l.contracts,
           COALESCE(
             CASE WHEN l.bank_type = 'union'
                  THEN (SELECT w.insurance_wallet FROM public.union_wallets w
                         WHERE w.union_id = l.bank_entity_id)
                  ELSE (SELECT c.insurance_balance FROM public.club_wallets c
                         WHERE c.club_id = l.bank_entity_id) END,
             0) AS stored_balance
    FROM led l
  )
  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'insurance_bank', j.bank_entity_id, j.ledger_balance, j.stored_balance,
    CASE
      WHEN ABS(j.stored_balance - j.ledger_balance) = 0     THEN 'ok'
      WHEN ABS(j.stored_balance - j.ledger_balance) <= 0.01 THEN 'warn'
      ELSE 'critical'
    END,
    jsonb_build_object('source', 'reconcile_ledger_nightly',
                       'bank_type', j.bank_type, 'contracts', j.contracts)
  FROM joined j;

  -- INSURANCE FUNNEL INTEGRITY (added 2026-08-28): every offer must resolve.
  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'insurance_offer_unresolved', u.player_id, u.offered, u.resolved, 'critical',
         jsonb_build_object('source', 'reconcile_ledger_nightly',
                            'table_id', u.table_id, 'hand_number', u.hand_number,
                            'last_offer', u.last_offer)
  FROM public.fn_unresolved_insurance_offers('1 day'::interval) u;

  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'seat_stack_exit', x.user_id, x.stack, 0, 'critical',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'source', 'fn_unaccounted_seat_exits',
           'exit_id', x.exit_id, 'table_id', x.table_id,
           'club_id', x.club_id, 'exit_kind', x.exit_kind,
           'db_role', x.db_role, 'app_name', x.app_name,
           'occurred_at', x.occurred_at)
  FROM public.fn_unaccounted_seat_exits('1 day'::interval) x;

  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'chip_circulation', c.club_id, c.on_the_felt, c.total, 'ok',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'source', 'fn_club_chip_circulation',
           'club_name', c.club_name,
           'member_wallets', c.member_wallets,
           'on_the_felt', c.on_the_felt,
           'treasury', c.treasury)
  FROM public.fn_club_chip_circulation() c
  WHERE c.total <> 0;

  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'cashout_escrow_stuck', e.player_id, e.amount, 0, 'critical',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'source', 'cashier_integrity',
           'escrow_id', e.id, 'cashout_id', e.cashout_request_id,
           'club_id', e.club_id, 'request_status', cr.status,
           'shape', CASE WHEN e.released_at IS NULL THEN 'unreleased_on_closed_request'
                         ELSE 'released_on_pending_request' END)
  FROM public.chip_escrow e
  JOIN public.cashout_requests cr ON cr.id = e.cashout_request_id
  WHERE (e.released_at IS NULL AND cr.status <> 'pending')
     OR (e.released_at IS NOT NULL AND cr.status = 'pending');

  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'negative_balance', t.entity_id, t.amount, 0, 'critical',
         jsonb_build_object('source', 'cashier_integrity', 'pool', t.pool, 'club_id', t.club_id)
  FROM (
    SELECT a.user_id AS entity_id, a.agent_wallet_balance AS amount, 'agent_wallet' AS pool, a.club_id
      FROM public.agents a WHERE COALESCE(a.agent_wallet_balance, 0) < 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a.user_id, a.promo_wallet_balance, 'promo_wallet', a.club_id
      FROM public.agents a WHERE COALESCE(a.promo_wallet_balance, 0) < 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.user_id, m.chip_balance, 'player_wallet', m.club_id
      FROM public.club_members m WHERE COALESCE(m.chip_balance, 0) < 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, c.chip_treasury, 'club_treasury', c.id
      FROM public.clubs c WHERE COALESCE(c.chip_treasury, 0) < 0
  ) t;

  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'over_claimed_send', ct.from_user_id,
         COALESCE((ct.metadata ->> 'claimed_back')::numeric, 0), ct.amount, 'critical',
         jsonb_build_object('source', 'cashier_integrity',
                            'transaction_id', ct.id, 'club_id', ct.club_id)
  FROM public.chip_transactions ct
  WHERE ct.transaction_type = 'agent_wallet_send'
    AND COALESCE((ct.metadata ->> 'claimed_back')::numeric, 0) > ct.amount;

  -- BOMB-POT AWARD LEDGER (added 2026-08-29)
  INSERT INTO public.ledger_reconcile_log
    (entity_type, entity_id, ledger_balance, stored_balance, severity, metadata)
  SELECT 'bomb_award_ledger_gap', NULL, g.net_winnings, g.ledger_total, 'critical',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'source', 'fn_bomb_pot_ledger_gaps',
           'hand_history_id', g.hand_history_id,
           'table_id', g.table_id,
           'hand_number', g.hand_number,
           'occurred_at', g.occurred_at,
           'board_count', g.board_count,
           'trigger_reason', g.trigger_reason,
           'award_units', g.award_units)
  FROM public.fn_bomb_pot_ledger_gaps('1 day'::interval) g;

  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::INT                                          AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'ok')::INT           AS ok,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'warn')::INT         AS warn,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical')::INT     AS crit,
    COALESCE(MAX(ABS(stored_balance - ledger_balance)), 0) AS worst
  INTO v_total, v_ok, v_warn, v_crit, v_worst
  FROM public.ledger_reconcile_log
  WHERE run_date = CURRENT_DATE;

  total_checked  := v_total;
  ok_count       := v_ok;
  warn_count     := v_warn;
  critical_count := v_crit;
  worst_drift    := v_worst;
  RETURN NEXT;
END;
$function$
