public.trg_agent_commission_rollup_chang.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_agent_commission_rollup_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_pairs jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    -- Transition tables cannot be combined with a column list on the
    -- trigger, so the trigger fires on every UPDATE and the filter is here:
    -- only rows whose outstanding amount, settlement or ownership changed
    -- name a pair to recompute. A notes-only update names none.
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('club_id', x.club_id, 'user_id', x.user_id)), '[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_pairs
      FROM (
        SELECT o.club_id, o.user_id
          FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
         WHERE o.settled_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.settled_at
            OR o.amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.amount
            OR o.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.club_id
            OR o.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.user_id
        UNION
        SELECT n.club_id, n.user_id
          FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
         WHERE o.settled_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.settled_at
            OR o.amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.amount
            OR o.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.club_id
            OR o.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.user_id
      ) x;

    -- Phase 6: the day total moves only when amount, club or day moved.
    -- Subtract the old row, add the new one; a settlement changes neither.
    INSERT INTO public.ca_club_commission_daily AS c
           (club_id, stat_date, amount, rows_counted, updated_at)
    SELECT x.club_id, x.d, sum(x.amount), sum(x.n), now()
      FROM (
        SELECT o.club_id, (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d, -o.amount AS amount, -1 AS n
          FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
         WHERE o.amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.amount
            OR o.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.club_id
            OR o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n.club_id, (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, n.amount, 1
          FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
         WHERE o.amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.amount
            OR o.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.club_id
            OR o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
      ) x
     WHERE x.club_id IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY x.club_id, x.d
    ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE
       SET amount       = c.amount + EXCLUDED.amount,
           rows_counted = c.rows_counted + EXCLUDED.rows_counted,
           updated_at   = now();
  ELSE
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('club_id', o.club_id, 'user_id', o.user_id)), '[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_pairs
      FROM old_rows o;

    INSERT INTO public.ca_club_commission_daily AS c
           (club_id, stat_date, amount, rows_counted, updated_at)
    SELECT o.club_id, (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, -sum(o.amount), -count(*), now()
      FROM old_rows o
     WHERE o.club_id IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY o.club_id, (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
    ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE
       SET amount       = c.amount + EXCLUDED.amount,
           rows_counted = c.rows_counted + EXCLUDED.rows_counted,
           updated_at   = now();
  END IF;
  IF v_pairs <> '[]'::jsonb THEN
    PERFORM public.fn_agent_commission_rollup_recompute(v_pairs);
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

public.trg_agent_commission_rollup_inser.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_agent_commission_rollup_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_club uuid;
BEGIN
  /* ONE KEY PER CLUB, IN CLUB ORDER, BEFORE ITS ROLLUP ROWS (2026-10-01).
     Each commission row takes its agent's unsettled row and then the club's
     day row, so a writer with two tiers held the day row while it asked for
     its second agent's row - which a tournament finish, holding that agent's
     row, was waiting to pass on its way to the day row. The club's
     commission key comes first, in club order: the cash accrual batch takes
     every key it will need before its first item (fn_credit_agent_commissions_batch,
     fn_retry_cash_accounting_sources), a finish takes them here source by
     source in club order, and within one club only its holder writes these
     rows. The sums below are unchanged. */
  FOR v_club IN SELECT DISTINCT n.club_id FROM new_rows n WHERE n.club_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY n.club_id LOOP
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('agent-commission:'||v_club::text,0));
  END LOOP;

  INSERT INTO public.agent_commission_unsettled_rollup AS r
         (club_id, user_id, owed, rows_behind, oldest_unsettled, updated_at)
  SELECT n.club_id, n.user_id,
         sum(n.amount), count(*), min(n.created_at), now()
    FROM new_rows n
   WHERE n.settled_at IS NULL AND n.club_id IS NOT NULL AND n.user_id IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT public.fn_agent_commission_paid_by_period(n.club_id, n.user_id, n.created_at)
   GROUP BY n.club_id, n.user_id
  ON CONFLICT (club_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
     SET owed             = r.owed + EXCLUDED.owed,
         rows_behind      = r.rows_behind + EXCLUDED.rows_behind,
         oldest_unsettled = least(r.oldest_unsettled, EXCLUDED.oldest_unsettled),
         updated_at       = now();

  -- Phase 6: the per-day total the Financials page reads.
  INSERT INTO public.ca_club_commission_daily AS c
         (club_id, stat_date, amount, rows_counted, updated_at)
  SELECT n.club_id, (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, sum(n.amount), count(*), now()
    FROM new_rows n
   WHERE n.club_id IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY n.club_id, (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
  ON CONFLICT (club_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE
     SET amount       = c.amount + EXCLUDED.amount,
         rows_counted = c.rows_counted + EXCLUDED.rows_counted,
         updated_at   = now();
  -- Original INSERT deltas are synchronous, even for not-yet-qualified days.
  -- Such rows remain unread until an explicit locked baseline marks completeness.
  INSERT INTO smarter_private.agent_commission_report_daily AS d(club_id,day,user_id,amount)
  SELECT n.club_id,(n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,n.user_id,COALESCE(SUM(n.amount),0)
    FROM new_rows n
   WHERE n.club_id IS NOT NULL AND n.user_id IS NOT NULL AND n.created_at IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY n.club_id,(n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,n.user_id
  ON CONFLICT(club_id,day,user_id) DO UPDATE SET amount=d.amount+EXCLUDED.amount;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

public.trg_ca_reporting_repair_changed_d.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_ca_reporting_repair_changed_days()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r record;
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'wallet_transactions' THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT x.d FROM (
          SELECT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.amount
              OR o.type IS DISTINCT FROM n.type
              OR o.category IS DISTINCT FROM n.category
              OR o.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.user_id
              OR o.table_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.table_id
              OR o.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.related_entity_id
              OR o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
          UNION
          SELECT (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
        ) x
        ORDER BY x.d
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);
      END LOOP;
    ELSE
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
          FROM old_rows o ORDER BY 1
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);
      END LOOP;
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'rake_records' THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT x.d FROM (
          SELECT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.rake_amount IS DISTINCT FROM n.rake_amount
              OR o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
              OR o.tournament_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.tournament_id
              OR o.is_tournament IS DISTINCT FROM n.is_tournament
              OR o.metadata IS DISTINCT FROM n.metadata
              OR o.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.club_id
          UNION
          SELECT (n.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
            FROM old_rows o JOIN new_rows n ON n.id = o.id
           WHERE o.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM n.created_at
        ) x
        ORDER BY x.d
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);
      END LOOP;
    ELSE
      FOR r IN
        SELECT DISTINCT (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
          FROM old_rows o ORDER BY 1
      LOOP
        PERFORM public.ca_refresh_reporting_rollups(r.d, r.d);
      END LOOP;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RAISE WARNING 'Club Data changed-ledger repair failed on %: %', TG_TABLE_NAME, SQLERRM;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(NEW.club_id,NEW.created_at) OR (public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('union',NEW.union_id) IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.created_at IS NULL OR NEW.created_at<public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('union',NEW.union_id))) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF NEW.union_id IS NOT NULL
     AND NEW.wallet = 'rake_wallet'
     AND NEW.direction = 'credit'
     AND NEW.tx_type = 'rake' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.union_rake_weekly (union_id, club_id, week_start, rake_total, updated_at)
    VALUES (NEW.union_id, NEW.club_id, date_trunc('week', NEW.created_at)::date,
            COALESCE(NEW.amount, 0), now())
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT union_rake_weekly_key DO UPDATE
      SET rake_total = public.union_rake_weekly.rake_total + EXCLUDED.rake_total,
          updated_at = now();
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Never let a display rollup block the engine banking rake. A failure here
  -- costs a stale panel; the function's fallback still reads the ledger.
  RAISE WARNING 'union_rake_weekly maintenance failed for tx %: %', NEW.id, SQLERRM;
  RETURN NULL;

public.trivia_ledger_platform_family(p_k.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trivia_ledger_platform_family(p_kind text, p_reference text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_kind IN ('pvp_stake', 'pvp_win', 'pvp_refund', 'pvp_tie_refund')

smarter_private.assert_own_agent_scope_i.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.assert_own_agent_scope_interpreted(p_kind text, p_scope uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_round integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- The original paid receipt always decides its own replay, including books
 -- with a later approved adjustment. This guard never upgrades a paid source.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_routed_settlement_runs r WHERE r.scope_kind=p_kind AND r.scope_id=p_scope AND r.period_start=p_from AND r.period_end=p_to AND r.round_no=p_round)THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_own_agent_preparation_versions v WHERE v.scope_kind=p_kind AND v.scope_id=p_scope AND v.period_start=p_from AND v.period_end=p_to AND v.version='own-agent-v1'AND v.owner_hashes=jsonb_build_object('producer',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_accounting_earning_contract(uuid,uuid,numeric,uuid,timestamptz)'::regprocedure)),'calculator',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_calculate_cash_rakeback_periods(uuid,date,date,uuid[])'::regprocedure)),'split_check',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_rakeback_split_check(uuid,date,date,uuid[])'::regprocedure)),'split_write',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_rakeback_split_write(uuid,date,date,uuid[])'::regprocedure))))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_agent_source_interpretation_required_before_payment' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 -- Historical entitlement survives suspension. Frozen, missing or ambiguous
 -- current own-agent destinations cannot accept a new transfer. Deleted
 -- profiles retain the original documented discharge transaction below.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s WHERE s.earned_at>=p_from AND s.earned_at<p_to AND((p_kind='union'AND s.coordinator_union_id=p_scope)OR(p_kind='club'AND s.club_id=p_scope AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL))AND coalesce(s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,role}','')IN('super_agent','agent','sub_agent')AND s.contract#>>'{tiers,0,user_id}'IS DISTINCT FROM s.player_id::text
 AND NOT(coalesce((s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,player_rakeback_pct}')::numeric=.70,false)AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id=s.club_id AND c.owner_id=NULLIF(s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,agent_id}','')::uuid))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_own_agent_source_reviews a WHERE a.source_type=s.source_type AND a.source_id=s.source_id AND a.version='own-agent-v1'AND a.effective_contract_md5=md5(s.contract::text)))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_agent_source_interpretation_pending' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s LEFT JOIN public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources f ON f.id=CASE WHEN s.source_type='tournament_fee_accrual'THEN s.source_id END
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*)n,min(a.status)status,min(a.role)role FROM public.agents a WHERE a.club_id=s.club_id AND a.user_id=s.player_id)g
 WHERE s.earned_at>=p_from AND s.earned_at<p_to AND((p_kind='union'AND s.coordinator_union_id=p_scope)OR(p_kind='club'AND s.club_id=p_scope AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL))AND s.rake_credit>0
 AND coalesce(s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,role}','')IN('super_agent','agent','sub_agent')
 AND(s.contract#>>'{tiers,0,user_id}'=s.player_id::text OR smarter_private.own_agent_destination_contract(s.contract,s.club_id,s.player_id,CASE WHEN s.source_type='tournament_fee_accrual'THEN public.fn_accounting_tournament_source_terms_at(f.tournament_id,f.charged_at,f.contract)ELSE s.earned_at END)IS NOT NULL)
 AND(g.n<>1 OR coalesce(g.role,'')NOT IN('super_agent','agent','sub_agent')OR(coalesce(g.status,'')NOT IN('active','suspended')AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=s.player_id AND p.status='deleted'))))THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_agent_current_destination_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;

END $function$

smarter_private.deleted_wallet_published.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.deleted_wallet_published_rakeback_reserve(p_club uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 r public.rakeback_periods%ROWTYPE;
 c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
 reserved numeric:=0;
 locked_period_ids uuid[];
BEGIN
 IF p_club IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_identity_required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
 END IF;
 -- Publishers lock an existing period FOR UPDATE before adding its certificate.
 -- NOWAIT is essential: caller may already own the member row, while the
 -- ordinary stage owns period rows before member rows. Never wait in reverse.
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(locked.id ORDER BY locked.id),ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO locked_period_ids
 FROM (SELECT rp.id FROM public.rakeback_periods rp
       WHERE rp.club_id=p_club AND rp.status='pending'
       ORDER BY rp.id FOR SHARE NOWAIT) locked;
 -- Visit ONLY the locked admission cohort, not a second fresh pending scan.
 FOR r IN SELECT rp.* FROM public.rakeback_periods rp
          WHERE rp.id=ANY(locked_period_ids) ORDER BY rp.id
 LOOP
  -- Select latest FIRST. An invalid latest certificate must not expose funds
  -- by falling back to an older certificate or disappearing from a filtered sum.
  SELECT pc.* INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations pc
  WHERE pc.period_id=r.id ORDER BY pc.id DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_latest_certificate_required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;
  IF r.id IS NULL OR r.club_id IS NULL OR r.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_club
   OR r.user_id IS NULL OR r.period_start IS NULL OR r.period_end IS NULL
   OR NOT isfinite(r.period_start) OR NOT isfinite(r.period_end)
   OR r.period_start>r.period_end OR extract(isodow FROM r.period_start)<>1 OR r.period_end<>r.period_start+6
   OR r.rake_generated IS NULL OR r.total_rake_paid IS NULL
   OR r.rakeback_amount IS NULL OR r.rakeback_earned IS NULL OR r.rakeback_rate IS NULL
   OR c.id IS NULL OR c.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.id
   OR c.accounting_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2
   OR c.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.club_id OR c.player_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.user_id
   OR c.period_start IS DISTINCT FROM r.period_start OR c.period_end IS DISTINCT FROM r.period_end
   OR c.rake_generated IS NULL OR c.rake_generated IS DISTINCT FROM r.rake_generated
   OR c.rake_generated IS DISTINCT FROM r.total_rake_paid
   OR c.rake_generated<0 OR c.rake_generated::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR c.rakeback_amount IS NULL OR c.rakeback_amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_amount
   OR c.rakeback_amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_earned
   OR c.rakeback_amount<0 OR c.rakeback_amount>c.rake_generated OR c.rakeback_amount<>round(c.rakeback_amount,2)
   OR c.rakeback_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR c.display_rate IS NULL OR c.display_rate IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_rate
   OR c.display_rate<0 OR c.display_rate>1 OR c.display_rate<>round(c.display_rate,4)
   OR c.display_rate::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR c.payer_kind IS NULL OR c.payer_kind NOT IN ('agent','club','split')
   OR (c.payer_kind='agent') IS DISTINCT FROM (c.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR c.payer_user_id=r.user_id
   OR c.source_fingerprint IS NULL OR c.source_fingerprint !~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'
  THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_certificate_identity_invalid' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;
  -- The owning R3 stage refuses any existing payout for a pending period.
  -- A pending row plus a paid receipt must never be mistaken for free money.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts pp WHERE pp.rakeback_period_id=r.id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted_wallet_reserve_pending_payout_conflict' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;
  IF c.payer_kind='split' THEN
   -- Same immutable certificate producer; retain all child liabilities before
   -- any deleted account's free net is returned by the existing R2/R3 owner.
   reserved:=reserved+COALESCE((SELECT sum(g.owed) FROM smarter_private.deleted_reserve_certificate_payers(c.id)g WHERE g.payer_kind='agent' AND g.payer_user=p_user),0);
  ELSIF c.payer_kind='agent' AND c.payer_user_id=p_user THEN
   reserved:=reserved+c.rakeback_amount;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN reserved;
END;
$function$

smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transf.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_complete(p_role text, p_obligation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE a smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_allocations%ROWTYPE;i smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_instructions%ROWTYPE;
 l public.chip_ledger%ROWTYPE;r public.chip_ledger%ROWTYPE;tx public.chip_transactions%ROWTYPE;op public.cashier_rpc_operation_intents%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO a FROM smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_allocations WHERE obligation_role=p_role AND obligation_id=p_obligation;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO i FROM smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_instructions WHERE id=a.instruction_id;
 SELECT * INTO l FROM public.chip_ledger WHERE id=a.original_ledger_id;
 SELECT * INTO tx FROM public.chip_transactions WHERE id=a.original_transaction_id;
 SELECT * INTO op FROM public.cashier_rpc_operation_intents WHERE operation_id=a.original_operation_id;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.chip_ledger WHERE id=a.reimbursement_ledger_id;
 IF i.id IS NULL OR l.id IS NULL OR tx.id IS NULL OR op.operation_id IS NULL OR r.id IS NULL
 OR a.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.club_id OR a.beneficiary_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.beneficiary_id OR a.period_start IS DISTINCT FROM i.period_start OR a.period_end IS DISTINCT FROM i.period_end
 OR NOT(a.obligation_role=ANY(i.roles)) OR a.original_ledger_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.original_ledger_id
 OR a.original_evidence->'instruction'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(i)OR a.original_evidence->'ledger'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(l)
 OR a.original_evidence->'transaction'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(tx)OR a.original_evidence->'cashier_operation'IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(op)
 OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent_send'OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM a.original_credit
 OR tx.is_reversed IS DISTINCT FROM false OR tx.clawed_back IS DISTINCT FROM false OR(tx.metadata->>'claimed_back')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 OR(SELECT sum(amount)FROM smarter_private.existing_rakeback_transfer_allocations WHERE original_ledger_id=l.id)>l.amount
 OR r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'OR r.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'treasury_transfer'OR r.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.club_id
 OR r.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'club_treasury'OR r.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.club_id OR r.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent_wallet'OR r.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.original_payer_id
 OR r.amount IS DISTINCT FROM a.amount OR r.pre_from_balance-r.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM a.amount OR r.post_to_balance-r.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM a.amount
 OR r.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'existing-rakeback-reimbursement:v1:'||a.obligation_role||':'||a.obligation_id::text
 OR r.metadata->>'payment_method'IS DISTINCT FROM 'owner_confirmed_existing_transfer'
 OR(r.metadata->>'period_start')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM a.period_start OR(r.metadata->>'period_end')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM a.period_end
 OR r.metadata->>'existing_transfer_allocation_id'IS DISTINCT FROM a.id::text OR r.metadata->>'original_ledger_id'IS DISTINCT FROM a.original_ledger_id::text
 OR r.metadata->>'beneficiary_id'IS DISTINCT FROM a.beneficiary_id::text OR r.metadata->>'obligation_role'IS DISTINCT FROM a.obligation_role
 OR r.metadata->>'actual_prior_destination'IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'OR r.metadata->>'source_fingerprint'IS DISTINCT FROM a.source_fingerprint
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices d WHERE d.source_ledger_id=r.id AND d.status='paid'AND d.chips_transferred AND d.message_sent AND d.gross_amount=a.amount AND d.net_amount=a.amount AND d.deductions=0)<>1
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF a.obligation_role='player' THEN
  RETURN EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rakeback_periods rp JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations c ON c.period_id=rp.id
   JOIN public.rakeback_period_payouts pp ON pp.id=a.payout_id AND pp.rakeback_period_id=rp.id
   WHERE rp.id=a.obligation_id AND rp.status='paid'AND rp.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND rp.user_id=a.beneficiary_id AND rp.club_id=a.club_id AND rp.rakeback_amount=a.amount
   AND c.id=a.certificate_id AND c.id=(SELECT max(z.id)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations z WHERE z.period_id=rp.id)
   AND c.source_fingerprint=a.source_fingerprint AND c.rakeback_amount=a.amount AND c.player_id=a.beneficiary_id AND c.club_id=a.club_id
   AND pp.status='paid'AND pp.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND pp.user_id=a.beneficiary_id AND pp.club_id=a.club_id AND pp.payout_amount=a.amount AND pp.wallet_transaction_id IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.wallet_transactions w WHERE w.related_entity_id=a.payout_id AND w.category='rakeback')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_transfers pt WHERE pt.payout_id=a.payout_id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.chip_ledger extra WHERE extra.club_id=a.club_id AND extra.to_entity_id=a.beneficiary_id AND extra.category='rakeback'AND extra.metadata->>'payout_id'=a.payout_id::text));
 END IF;
 RETURN a.obligation_role='commission'AND a.certificate_id IS NULL AND a.payout_id IS NULL
 AND(SELECT count(*)FROM public.agent_commission_settlements cs WHERE cs.club_id=a.club_id AND cs.user_id=a.beneficiary_id AND cs.period_start=a.period_start AND cs.period_end=a.period_end AND cs.amount=a.amount AND cs.paid_at IS NOT NULL)=1;
EXCEPTION WHEN data_exception OR check_violation OR no_data_found THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.historical_rakeback_wallet_admission(p_period uuid, p_certificate bigint, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.rakeback_periods%ROWTYPE; c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
 n bigint; distinct_n bigint; generated numeric; unrounded numeric; source_n bigint; bad boolean;
BEGIN
 IF public.fn_caller_is_engine() IS DISTINCT FROM true OR public.fn_platform_frozen() IS DISTINCT FROM false
 OR p_period IS NULL OR p_certificate IS NULL OR p_start IS NULL OR p_end IS NULL
 OR NOT isfinite(p_start) OR NOT isfinite(p_end) OR p_start IS DISTINCT FROM public.fn_union_week_start(p_start) OR p_end IS DISTINCT FROM public.fn_union_week_start(p_start+interval '8 days') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical_wallet_admission_refused' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF to_regclass('pg_temp._routed_player_todo') IS NULL OR to_regclass('pg_temp._routed_player_funding') IS NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('pg_temp._routed_player_todo') AND pg_get_userbyid(relowner)='postgres')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('pg_temp._routed_player_funding') AND pg_get_userbyid(relowner)='postgres')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical_wallet_native_stage_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.rakeback_periods WHERE id=p_period FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical_wallet_period_required'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE period_id=r.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND OR c.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_certificate OR c.accounting_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2
 OR r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'pending' OR c.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.club_id OR c.player_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.user_id
 OR c.period_start IS DISTINCT FROM r.period_start OR c.period_end IS DISTINCT FROM r.period_end
 OR r.period_start IS DISTINCT FROM (p_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date
 OR r.period_end IS DISTINCT FROM ((p_end AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date-1)
 OR c.rake_generated IS NULL OR c.rake_generated IS DISTINCT FROM r.rake_generated OR c.rake_generated IS DISTINCT FROM r.total_rake_paid
 OR c.rakeback_amount IS NULL OR c.rakeback_amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_amount OR c.rakeback_amount IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_earned
 OR c.display_rate IS NULL OR c.display_rate IS DISTINCT FROM r.rakeback_rate
 OR c.rakeback_amount<=0 OR c.rakeback_amount>c.rake_generated OR c.rakeback_amount<>round(c.rakeback_amount,2)
 OR c.rakeback_amount::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR c.source_fingerprint IS NULL OR c.source_fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{32}$'
 OR jsonb_typeof(c.source_allocations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts WHERE rakeback_period_id=r.id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.profiles WHERE id=r.user_id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.clubs WHERE id=r.club_id AND asset='chips' AND lifecycle_status='active')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical_wallet_latest_positive_certificate_required'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp._routed_player_todo WHERE period_id=p_period AND certificate_id=p_certificate AND club_id=r.club_id AND user_id=r.user_id AND owed=c.rakeback_amount AND owed>0)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_temp._routed_player_funding WHERE club_id=r.club_id AND payer_kind='agent' AND payer_user=r.user_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical_wallet_payer_restoration_refused'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT ROW(a->>'source_type',a->>'source_id')),
 sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric),sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric),
 coalesce(bool_or(s.source_id IS NULL OR s.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.club_id OR s.player_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.user_id
 OR s.coordinator_union_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.coordinator_union_id OR s.earned_at<p_start OR s.earned_at>=p_end
 OR s.rake_credit IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric OR s.rake_record_id IS DISTINCT FROM (a->>'rake_record_id')::uuid
 OR (a->>'rate')::numeric IS NULL OR (a->>'rate')::numeric<0 OR (a->>'rate')::numeric>1 OR (a->>'rate')::numeric::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR h.id IS NULL OR h.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'club_members' OR h.entity_key IS DISTINCT FROM r.club_id::text||':'||r.user_id::text
 OR h.after_terms IS DISTINCT FROM s.contract#>'{membership,terms}' OR h.observed_at>s.earned_at
 OR s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,club_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM r.club_id::text
 OR s.contract#>>'{membership,terms,user_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM r.user_id::text),true)
 INTO n,distinct_n,generated,unrounded,bad
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.source_allocations)a
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT s.* FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s WHERE s.source_type=a->>'source_type' AND s.source_id=(a->>'source_id')::uuid OFFSET 0)s ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT h.* FROM public.accounting_agreement_history h WHERE h.id=(s.contract#>>'{membership,history_id}')::bigint OFFSET 0)h ON true;
 SELECT count(*) INTO source_n FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s WHERE s.club_id=r.club_id AND s.player_id=r.user_id
 AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.coordinator_union_id AND s.earned_at>=p_start AND s.earned_at<p_end;
 IF n=0 OR n<>distinct_n OR n<>source_n OR generated IS DISTINCT FROM c.rake_generated OR round(unrounded,2) IS DISTINCT FROM c.rakeback_amount
 OR bad IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical_wallet_original_history_required'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('club_id',r.club_id,'user_id',r.user_id,'certificate_id',c.id,'period_id',r.id,'source_fingerprint',c.source_fingerprint);
END $function$

smarter_private.original_restoration_cas.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_restoration_cash_returns(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;f jsonb;p jsonb;t jsonb;l jsonb;scope jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_union_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF p_start IS NULL OR p_end IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_start) OR NOT isfinite(p_end) OR p_end<=p_start THEN RETURN;END IF;
 FOR c IN SELECT k.* FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_cases k
 JOIN smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_certificates z USING(event_id)
 WHERE k.family='returned_cash' AND z.boundary='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'
 AND z.witness_md5=k.witness_md5 AND z.proof_md5=md5(z.proof::text)
 AND z.original_witness=k.original_witness LOOP
  IF (c.original_witness#>>'{original_chip_transaction,created_at}')::timestamptz<p_start OR (c.original_witness#>>'{original_chip_transaction,created_at}')::timestamptz>=p_end THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  f:=smarter_private.original_inventory_finite_witness(c.event_id);
  IF f IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_restoration_cash_flow_source_refused' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  p:=smarter_private.original_returned_cash_base_proof(f,'2026-10-05 07:00:00Z','2026-10-12 07:00:00Z');
  t:=f->'original_chip_transaction';l:=f->'base_ledger';scope:=f->'original_table_scope';
  IF p->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR p->'financial_admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR scope->>'union_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_union_id::text OR scope->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM f#>>'{event,before_row,table_id}'
  OR scope->'is_private' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR scope->'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR f#>>'{original_manifest_scope,asset}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
  OR f#>'{original_manifest_scope,unit_scale}' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'::jsonb
  OR f#>>'{original_manifest_scope,game_union_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_union_id::text
  OR f#>'{original_manifest_scope,tournament_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR t->>'transaction_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'seat_credit_restored'
  OR t#>>'{metadata,restore_key}' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key'
  OR t->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM scope->>'id' OR t->>'to_user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'original_user'
  OR t->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'original_owner'
  OR t->'is_reversed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR t->'clawed_back' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR (t->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (p->>'original_base_returned')::numeric
  OR (t->>'created_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (f#>>'{base_mint,created_at}')::timestamptz
  OR (t->>'created_at')::timestamptz<p_start OR (t->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=p_end
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows old WHERE old.ledger_id=(l->>'id')::uuid)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_restoration_cash_flow_proof_refused' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  ledger_id:=(l->>'id')::uuid;club_id:=(p->>'original_owner')::uuid;user_id:=(p->>'original_user')::uuid;
  buyins:=0;cashouts:=(p->>'original_base_returned')::numeric;kind:='cash_return';valid:=true;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
END $function$

smarter_private.original_returned_cash_b.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_returned_cash_base_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE e jsonb;p jsonb;b jsonb;x jsonb;s jsonb;l jsonb;m jsonb;w jsonb;native jsonb;uid text;club text;base numeric;
BEGIN
 e:=f->'event';p:=f->'prior';b:=e->'before_row';x:=f->'original_participant';s:=x->'stack';
 l:=f->'base_ledger';m:=f->'base_mint';w:=f->'base_idempotency';native:=f->'native';
 IF f IS NULL OR lo IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR e->>'source_name' IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_seats' OR e->>'operation' NOT IN('UPDATE','DELETE') OR e->>'operation' IS NULL
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'after_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR b-'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM (p->'after_row')-'left_at'
 OR p#>'{after_row,left_at}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR b->>'left_at' IS NULL
 OR (b->>'left_at')::timestamptz NOT BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:00Z' AND '2026-10-06 15:33:10Z'
 OR (p->>'event_id')::bigint >= (e->>'event_id')::bigint
 OR lo>=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz OR hi<=(e->>'observed_at')::timestamptz
 OR b->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'seat_id' OR b->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
 OR b->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'occupancy_id'
 OR (b->>'joined_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz
 OR jsonb_typeof(b->'stack') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(s->'stack_before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR (b->>'stack')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'stack_before')::numeric OR (b->>'stack')::numeric<=0
 OR x#>'{manifest_participant,funding_lineage,issues}' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(x#>'{manifest_participant,funding_receipts}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(x#>'{manifest_participant,funding_receipts}')=0
 OR native#>>'{stack_result,success}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR native#>>'{stack_result,conservation_checked}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR native#>>'{post_commit_result,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR native->>'post_commit_completed_at' IS NULL OR (native->>'post_commit_completed_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR native#>>'{stack_result,table_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'table_id'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(native#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}') ns
  WHERE ns->>'seat_id'=s->>'seat_id' AND ns->>'user_id'=s->>'user_id'
  AND (ns->>'stack_before')::numeric=(s->>'stack_before')::numeric AND (ns->>'stack')::numeric=(s->>'stack')::numeric
  AND (ns->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=(s->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz)
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_returned_cash_identity_refused');END IF;
 uid:=s->>'user_id';club:=x->>'funding_club_id';base:=(s->>'stack_before')::numeric;
 IF f ? 'custody' AND (f#>>'{custody,state}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed'
 OR f#>>'{custody,original_inventory_event}' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'event_id'
 OR f#>>'{custody,user_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM uid OR f#>>'{custody,occupancy_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'occupancy_id'
 OR f#>>'{custody,funding_club_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM club OR f#>>'{custody,restore_key}' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key'
 OR (f#>>'{custody,stack_before}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base
 OR (f#>>'{custody,stack_after}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'stack')::numeric
 OR f#>>'{custody,issuance_ledger}' IS DISTINCT FROM l->>'id') THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_consumed_custody_refused');END IF;
 IF club IS NULL OR f->>'restore_key' IS NULL OR l->>'idempotency_key' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key'
 OR l->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR l->>'row_hash' IS NULL
 OR l->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'issuance_reserve' OR l->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
 OR l->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid OR l->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM club OR l->>'category' IS DISTINCT FROM 'refund'
 OR (l->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base OR l->>'created_at' IS NULL
 OR (l->>'created_at')::timestamptz<=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz OR (l->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR m->>'op_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key' OR m->>'chip_ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM l->>'id'
 OR m->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mint' OR m->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
 OR m->>'holder_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player' OR m->>'holder_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid
 OR (m->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base
 OR w->>'key' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'restore_key' OR w->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM uid
 OR (w->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM base
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_returned_cash_receipts_refused');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'event_id',e->'event_id',
 'original_base_returned',base,'original_owner',club,'original_user',uid,'new_payment',false,
 'preserved_signed_delta',(s->>'stack')::numeric-base,'original_closed_held',0,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$
