CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_payers(p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(payer_kind text, payer_user uuid, payer_entity uuid, owed numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;plan jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF c.payer_kind<>'split' THEN
  IF c.payer_kind NOT IN('agent','club') OR(c.payer_kind='agent')IS DISTINCT FROM(c.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_certificate_payer_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT c.payer_kind,c.payer_user_id,COALESCE(c.payer_user_id,c.club_id),c.rakeback_amount;RETURN;
 END IF;
 plan:=smarter_private.rakeback_payer_plan(c.source_allocations,c.rakeback_amount);
 IF jsonb_array_length(plan)<2 OR c.payer_user_id IS NOT NULL
  OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_contracts g WHERE g.calculation_id=c.id)<>jsonb_array_length(plan)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan)p LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_payer_contracts g
   ON g.calculation_id=c.id AND g.payer_kind=p->>'payer_kind' AND g.payer_entity_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(p->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid,c.club_id)
   WHERE g.calculation_id IS NULL OR g.payer_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(p->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid
    OR g.amount IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'amount')::numeric OR g.unrounded IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'unrounded')::numeric
    OR g.rake IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'rake')::numeric OR g.source_count IS DISTINCT FROM(p->>'source_count')::bigint
    OR g.source_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint OR g.payer_user_id=c.player_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'split_rakeback_payer_contracts_disagree' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT g.payer_kind,g.payer_user_id,g.payer_entity_id,g.amount FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_contracts g
  WHERE g.calculation_id=c.id ORDER BY g.payer_kind,g.payer_entity_id;
END $function$

smarter_private.rakeback_payer_plan(p_al.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_payer_plan(p_allocations jsonb, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;expected numeric;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_allocations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_allocations)=0
 OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount<0 OR p_amount<>round(p_amount,2) OR p_amount::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_payer_plan_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_allocations)a
  WHERE a->>'payer_kind' IS NULL OR a->>'payer_kind' NOT IN('club','agent')
   OR (a->>'payer_kind'='agent') IS DISTINCT FROM(NULLIF(a->>'payer_user_id','') IS NOT NULL)
   OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric IS NULL OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric<0
   OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric<>round((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric,2)
   OR (a->>'rate')::numeric IS NULL OR (a->>'rate')::numeric<0 OR (a->>'rate')::numeric>1
   OR (a->>'rake_credit')::numeric::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR (a->>'rate')::numeric::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_payer_allocation_invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT round(sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric),2) INTO expected
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_allocations)a;
 IF expected IS DISTINCT FROM p_amount THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rakeback_payer_total_disagrees' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 WITH g AS(
  SELECT a->>'payer_kind' kind,NULLIF(a->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid payer,
   sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric) rake,sum((a->>'rake_credit')::numeric*(a->>'rate')::numeric) unrounded,count(*) n
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_allocations)a GROUP BY a->>'payer_kind',NULLIF(a->>'payer_user_id','')::uuid
 ), cents AS(
  SELECT g.*,floor(unrounded*100) whole,
   row_number() OVER(ORDER BY unrounded*100-floor(unrounded*100) DESC,kind,payer NULLS FIRST) remainder_rank,
   p_amount*100-sum(floor(unrounded*100)) OVER() extra FROM g
 )SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('payer_kind',kind,'payer_user_id',payer,'rake',rake,
   'unrounded',unrounded,'source_count',n,'amount',(whole+CASE WHEN remainder_rank<=extra THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/100)
   ORDER BY kind,payer NULLS FIRST) INTO result FROM cents;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

smarter_private.rakeback_wallet_payout_c.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_wallet_payout_complete(p_payout uuid, p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp public.rakeback_period_payouts%ROWTYPE;c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT*INTO pp FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts WHERE id=p_payout;
 SELECT*INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF pp.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR pp.status IS DISTINCT FROM'paid'OR pp.rakeback_period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR pp.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id OR pp.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR pp.payout_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.rakeback_amount
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rakeback_periods r WHERE r.id=c.period_id AND r.status='paid')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_contracts w WHERE w.calculation_id=c.id AND w.destination_kind='agent_wallet')THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_transfers t WHERE t.payout_id=pp.id)<>(SELECT count(*)FROM smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_wallets(c.id)g WHERE g.owed>0)THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT FROM smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_wallets(c.id)g
 LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_transfers t ON t.payout_id=pp.id AND t.payer_kind=g.payer_kind AND t.payer_entity_id=g.payer_entity AND t.destination_kind=g.destination_kind
 LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=t.ledger_id LEFT JOIN public.wallet_transactions w ON w.id=t.wallet_transaction_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT CASE WHEN g.payer_kind='club'OR g.payer_user IS NULL OR(l.from_type='club_treasury'AND l.metadata->>'owner_share_payer'=g.payer_user::text)THEN'club_treasury'ELSE'agent_wallet'END kind)funded
 WHERE g.owed>0 AND(t.payout_id IS NULL OR t.calculation_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.id OR t.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR t.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
 OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id OR l.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM funded.kind OR l.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN funded.kind='club_treasury'THEN c.club_id ELSE g.payer_user END
 OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM g.destination_kind OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM'rakeback'OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM'posted'
 OR l.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM'round3-period:own-agent-v1:'||c.period_id||':payer:'||g.payer_kind||':'||g.payer_entity||':destination:'||g.destination_kind
 OR l.metadata?'certificate_kind'OR l.metadata->>'routing_version'IS DISTINCT FROM'3'
 OR l.metadata->>'accounting_scope_kind'IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN c.coordinator_union_id IS NULL THEN'club'ELSE'union'END
 OR l.metadata->>'accounting_scope_id'IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(c.coordinator_union_id,c.club_id)::text
 OR(l.metadata->>'period_start')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM(c.period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE'America/Los_Angeles')
 OR(l.metadata->>'period_end')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM((c.period_end+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE'America/Los_Angeles')
 OR l.metadata->>'wallet_transaction_id'IS DISTINCT FROM t.wallet_transaction_id::text
 OR l.metadata->>'paid_from'IS DISTINCT FROM funded.kind
 OR l.metadata->>'payee_role_at_transfer'IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN g.destination_kind='agent_wallet'THEN'agent'ELSE'player'END
 OR l.metadata->>'wallet_destination_version'IS DISTINCT FROM'own-agent-v1'OR l.metadata->>'destination_kind'IS DISTINCT FROM g.destination_kind
 OR l.metadata->>'certificate_id'IS DISTINCT FROM c.id::text OR l.metadata->>'payout_id'IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id::text OR l.metadata->>'period_id'IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id::text OR l.metadata->>'source_fingerprint'IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint
 OR l.pre_from_balance-l.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.post_to_balance-l.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
 OR w.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR w.type IS DISTINCT FROM'credit'OR w.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR w.wallet_type IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN g.destination_kind='agent_wallet'THEN'BUSINESS'ELSE'PLAYER'END
 OR w.category IS DISTINCT FROM'rakeback'OR w.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id OR w.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM l.post_to_balance
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices i WHERE i.source_ledger_id=l.id AND i.status='paid'AND i.chips_transferred AND i.message_sent AND i.net_amount=g.owed AND i.gross_amount=g.owed AND i.deductions=0)<>1));
EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation OR data_exception OR no_data_found THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

smarter_private.record_rakeback_payer_co.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.record_rakeback_payer_contracts()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM smarter_private.ensure_rakeback_payer_contracts(NEW.id);
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

smarter_private.split_rakeback_payout_co.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.split_rakeback_payout_complete(p_payout uuid, p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp public.rakeback_period_payouts%ROWTYPE;c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO pp FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts WHERE id=p_payout;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF pp.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR c.payer_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'split' OR pp.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'paid'
  OR pp.rakeback_period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR pp.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id
  OR pp.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR pp.payout_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.rakeback_amount
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.rakeback_periods r WHERE r.id=c.period_id AND r.status='paid')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_payer_transfers t WHERE t.payout_id=pp.id)
   <>(SELECT count(*)FROM smarter_private.deleted_reserve_certificate_payers(c.id)g WHERE g.owed>0)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.deleted_reserve_certificate_payers(c.id)g
 LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_payer_transfers t ON t.payout_id=pp.id AND t.payer_kind=g.payer_kind AND t.payer_entity_id=g.payer_entity
 LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=t.ledger_id
 LEFT JOIN public.wallet_transactions w ON w.id=t.wallet_transaction_id
 WHERE g.owed>0 AND(t.payout_id IS NULL OR t.calculation_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.id OR t.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id
  OR t.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id
  OR NOT COALESCE(CASE WHEN g.payer_kind='club' THEN l.from_type='club_treasury' AND l.from_entity_id=g.payer_entity
    WHEN l.from_type IN('player_wallet','agent_wallet') THEN l.from_entity_id=g.payer_entity
    ELSE l.from_type='club_treasury' AND l.from_entity_id=c.club_id AND l.metadata->>'owner_share_payer'=g.payer_entity::text END,false)
  OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'rakeback' OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
  OR l.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'round3-period:v3:'||c.period_id::text||':payer:'||g.payer_kind||':'||g.payer_entity::text
  OR l.metadata->>'certificate_id' IS DISTINCT FROM c.id::text OR l.metadata->>'payout_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id::text
  OR l.metadata->>'period_id' IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id::text OR l.metadata->>'source_fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint
  OR l.pre_from_balance-l.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.post_to_balance-l.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
  OR w.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR w.type IS DISTINCT FROM 'credit' OR w.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
  OR w.wallet_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'PLAYER' OR w.category IS DISTINCT FROM 'rakeback'
  OR w.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id OR w.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM l.post_to_balance
  OR(g.payer_kind='agent' AND l.from_type='player_wallet' AND(SELECT count(*)FROM public.wallet_transactions wd WHERE wd.related_entity_id=pp.id
    AND wd.user_id=g.payer_user AND wd.wallet_type='PLAYER' AND wd.type='debit' AND wd.category='rakeback'
    AND wd.amount=g.owed AND wd.balance_after=l.post_from_balance)<>1)
  OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices i WHERE i.source_ledger_id=l.id AND i.status='paid' AND i.chips_transferred
    AND i.message_sent AND i.gross_amount=g.owed AND i.net_amount=g.owed AND i.deductions=0)<>1));
EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation OR data_exception OR no_data_found THEN
 RETURN false;
END $function$

smarter_private.tournament_abort_ingress.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.tournament_abort_ingress(p_tournament_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.tournament_abort_targets a WHERE a.tournament_id=p_tournament_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.tournament_abort_recoveries r WHERE r.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND r.operation_id=a.operation_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'TOURNAMENT_OPERATOR_ABORT: new entry, rebuy or add-on is stopped' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
END $function$

smarter_private.union_pnl_original_flow_.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.union_pnl_original_flow_evidence_window(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_window_start timestamp with time zone, p_window_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
  FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q WHERE q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_window_start AND q.recognized_at<p_window_end
 ), rf_original_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.transaction_id,(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid table_id,
   (q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid user_id,(q.l->>'amount')::numeric amount
  FROM originals q
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
   AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
 ), rf_original_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount,count(*) refunds,
   min(o.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(o.user_id::text)::uuid player
  FROM rf_original_keys k
  JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.transaction_id=k.transaction_id
   AND a.refunded>0 AND a.refunded=k.amount
  JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts o ON o.id=a.funding_receipt_id
  WHERE a.pending_addon_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.pending_addon_id AND a.original_occupancy_id=o.occupancy_id
   AND o.table_id=k.table_id AND o.account_type='player_wallet' AND o.account_entity_id=k.user_id
   AND o.funding_club_id=k.club_id AND o.user_id=k.user_id
  GROUP BY k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount
 ), bbj_wallet_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.ledger_id,(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,r.user_id,r.amount,b.id payout_id
  FROM originals q
  JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=CASE WHEN q.l->>'idempotency_key' ~ '^bbj:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN split_part(q.l->>'idempotency_key',':',2)::uuid END
  JOIN public.bbj_payout_recipients r ON r.payout_id=b.id AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
  JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency w ON w.key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND w.user_id=r.user_id AND w.amount=r.amount
  JOIN public.bbj_pools pool ON pool.id=b.pool_id
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND q.l->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
   AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=b.table_id::text AND q.l->>'table_id'=b.table_id::text
   AND q.l->>'id'=q.ledger_id::text AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text
   AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND (pool.union_id=p_union_id OR (pool.union_id IS NULL AND pool.club_id::text=q.game_scope->>'host_club_id'))
   AND b.kind IN('main','mini') AND b.total_amount>0 AND b.total_amount=round(b.total_amount,2)
   AND b.created_at<=q.recognized_at AND r.created_at=w.created_at AND w.created_at>=b.created_at AND w.created_at<=q.recognized_at
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients unique_recipient WHERE unique_recipient.payout_id=b.id AND unique_recipient.user_id=r.user_id)=1
   AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric AND r.amount>0 AND r.amount=round(r.amount,2)
   AND r.amount::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions t WHERE t.transaction_type='bbj_payout' AND t.table_id=b.table_id
     AND t.to_user_id=r.user_id AND t.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND t.amount=r.amount AND t.created_at=w.created_at)=1
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger bank WHERE bank.status='posted' AND bank.category='bbj_payout'
     AND bank.from_type='bbj_pool' AND bank.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND bank.to_type='table_stack' AND bank.to_entity_id=b.table_id
     AND bank.amount=b.total_amount AND bank.idempotency_key=CASE WHEN b.kind='mini' THEN 'bbj_mini:'||b.pool_id::text||':'||b.table_id::text||':'||b.hand_number::text ELSE 'bbj_payout:'||b.id::text END)=1
   AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients p WHERE p.payout_id=b.id)
      +(SELECT coalesce(sum(u.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.paid_at IS NULL)=b.total_amount
   AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id)
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id AND u.amount=r.amount
       AND u.pool_id=b.pool_id AND u.table_id=b.table_id AND u.paid_at=w.created_at
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger parked WHERE parked.status='posted' AND parked.category='bbj_payout'
         AND parked.from_type='table_stack' AND parked.from_entity_id=b.table_id AND parked.to_type='bbj_pool' AND parked.to_entity_id=b.pool_id
         AND parked.amount=r.amount AND parked.idempotency_key='bbj_park:bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger redeemed WHERE redeemed.status='posted' AND redeemed.category='bbj_payout'
         AND redeemed.from_type='bbj_pool' AND redeemed.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND redeemed.to_type='table_stack' AND redeemed.to_entity_id=b.table_id
         AND redeemed.amount=r.amount AND redeemed.idempotency_key='bbj_redeem:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1)=1)
 ), matched AS (
  SELECT q.*,gift.proof treasury_gift,returned.proof treasury_return,f.id cash_funding_id,f.funding_club_id cash_club,f.user_id cash_user,f.amount cash_amount,
   e.id entry_id,e.funding_club_id entry_club,e.user_id entry_user,e.amount entry_amount,
   c.ledger_id credit_id,c.credited_club_id credit_club,c.user_id credit_user,c.amount credit_amount,
   ret.owners,ret.funding_club_id return_club,ret.user_id return_user,mv.moved_club,mv.moved_user,
   COALESCE(rf.refunds,0) refunds,rf.club refund_club,rf.player refund_user,te.refund_ent,te.refund_ent_user,te.refund_ent_club,late.n late_count,late.club late_club,late.player late_user,late.delta late_delta,j.club_id bbj_club,j.user_id bbj_user,j.payout_id bbj_payout
  FROM originals q
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT smarter_private.original_treasury_gift_evidence(q.ledger_id) proof
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='horse_funding'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='club_treasury' AND q.l->>'to_type'='table_stack') gift ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT smarter_private.original_treasury_return_evidence(q.ledger_id) proof
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet') returned ON true
  LEFT JOIN bbj_wallet_matches j ON j.ledger_id=q.ledger_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*) n,min(p.club_id::text)::uuid club,min(p.user_id::text)::uuid player,min(p.delta) delta
   FROM (SELECT q.ledger_id WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL
    AND q.l->>'category'='settlement' AND q.l->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%' OFFSET 0) eligible
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(eligible.ledger_id) p
  ) late ON true
  -- One-time filter (20261001): a probe only for the flows that can match.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.* FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND f.source_ledger_id=q.ledger_id OFFSET 0) f ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.* FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts e
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND e.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND e.asset='chips' AND q.tournament_id=e.tournament_id OFFSET 0) e ON true
  -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(q.tournament_id,NULL,p_start,p_end) for
  -- this flow's ledger only: its two branches verbatim, keyed by the ledger.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT c.ledger_id,c.tournament_id,c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount
   FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND c.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND c.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
   UNION ALL
   SELECT t.credit_ledger_id,t.tournament_id,t.user_id,t.source_wallet_club_id,t.amount_paid_now
   FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches t
   JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=t.entitlement_id
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=t.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c2 WHERE c2.ledger_id=t.credit_ledger_id)
  ) c ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.user_id)) owners,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid funding_club_id,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid user_id
   FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id')::uuid END occupancy_id
    FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
    WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=((q.l->>'table_id')::uuid)::text
    UNION
    SELECT original.occupancy_id FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a
     JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
     WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
   ) original_occupancies
   JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.occupancy_id=original_occupancies.occupancy_id
   WHERE r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid AND smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)
    AND q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND ((r.account_type=q.l->>'to_type' AND r.account_entity_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid) OR (r.operation_kind='horse_funding' AND r.account_type='club_treasury' AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid AND smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)))
    AND r.funding_club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id'=r.occupancy_id::text
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=r.table_id::text)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
       WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND original.occupancy_id=r.occupancy_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric))
  ) ret ON true
  -- A seat cashed out after it arrived by a table move holds chips whose
  -- original buy-in is on the source occupancy, not this one. The occupancy
  -- the cash-out vacated (its seat row in the same original transaction,
  -- carrying exactly the cashed-out stack) is traced through its move receipts
  -- by fn_cash_original_funding_lineage, the proof the boundaries and hands
  -- already use; the owner is its one original buy-in's club and player.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.club END moved_club,
    CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.player END moved_user
   FROM (SELECT min(i.before_row::text)::jsonb seat,count(*) n FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
     WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
      AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
      AND i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats' AND i.before_row->>'table_id'=q.l->>'table_id'
      AND i.before_row->>'user_id'=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND i.before_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb
      AND i.after_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL) s
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s.seat->>'user_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'table_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'id')::uuid,
     (s.seat->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,q.recognized_at,false) v) lin
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)) buyins,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,
     count(DISTINCT r.user_id) users,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid player
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(lin.v->'funding_receipts') ref JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid) own
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    AND s.n=1 AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s.seat->'stack') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) mv ON true
  -- A pending add-on returned unapplied is a refund of this player's own
  -- escrowed chips. Its wallet credit can carry no refund category: it runs
  -- inside the hand's post-commit obligations, after atomic_distribute_rake
  -- has declared that transaction's ledger context, so the audit labels it
  -- player_funding under the rake settlement. The application receipt
  -- written in the same transaction proves it: exactly one refund of this
  -- amount from a funding receipt of this player, club and table.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT r.refunds,r.club,r.player FROM rf_original_matches r
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
    AND r.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid
    AND r.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) rf ON true
  -- A seat won in a satellite and later refunded by the target tournament
  -- (cancelled, or the seat released) pays the seat's value back to the
  -- player's wallet from the target's prize liability. That seat was never a
  -- wallet-funded entry of the target, so no tournament credit receipt exists
  -- for it; its proof is the refund entitlement the payout is keyed by: same
  -- tournament, player, wallet club and gross, and the seat's owning club as
  -- resolved from its satellite registration.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT t.id refund_ent,t.user_id refund_ent_user,t.refund_wallet_club_id refund_ent_club
   FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements t
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='tourney:'||t.tournament_id::text||':refund-entitlement:'||t.id::text
    AND t.entitlement_kind IN('satellite_seat','wallet_charge','tournament_ticket') AND t.gross=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
    AND t.user_id::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND t.refund_wallet_club_id::text=q.l->>'club_id'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='refund'
    AND CASE t.entitlement_kind
     WHEN 'satellite_seat' THEN public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,NULL)=t.refund_wallet_club_id
     -- A pre-capture wallet entry refunded by cancellation (20261006154000):
     -- its entitlement's source ledger is the entry proven at the opening
     -- boundary of the refund's own week, for this exact registration, club
     -- and gross.
     WHEN 'wallet_charge' THEN t.source_ledger_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions r
       WHERE r.boundary=public.fn_union_week_start(q.recognized_at) AND r.union_id=p_union_id AND r.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND r.user_id=t.user_id
        AND r.owning_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id AND r.entries=1 AND r.entry_amount=t.gross AND r.returned=0
        AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
        AND r.proof->'entry_ledger' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('ledger_id',t.source_ledger_id::text)))=1
     WHEN 'tournament_ticket' THEN t.charge_category='tournament_ticket'
      AND t.evidence_kind='atomic_tournament_ticket' AND t.escrow_bucket='ticket_gross'
      AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=t.tournament_id::text
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets replacement WHERE replacement.source_refund_entitlement_id=t.id)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements duplicate WHERE duplicate.source_ticket_id=t.source_ticket_id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr
       WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id AND tr.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND tr.transaction_id=q.transaction_id
        AND tr.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tr.user_id=t.user_id AND tr.source_wallet_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tr.idempotency_key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND tr.amount_paid_before=0 AND tr.amount_paid_now=t.gross
        AND tr.refund_prize=t.refund_prize AND tr.refund_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tr.refund_fee=t.refund_fee)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_tickets tk
       JOIN public.chip_ledger admission ON admission.id=t.source_ledger_id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.ticket_id=tk.id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements h ON h.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
       JOIN public.tournament_payouts p ON p.id=a.payout_id
       JOIN public.chip_ledger issue ON issue.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key||':ticket_escrow'
       WHERE tk.id=t.source_ticket_id AND tk.holder_id=t.user_id AND tk.club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tk.status='redeemed' AND tk.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND tk.cancelled_at IS NULL
        AND tk.value=t.gross AND tk.entry_prize=t.refund_prize AND tk.entry_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tk.entry_fee=t.refund_fee
        AND t.gross=t.refund_prize+t.refund_bounty+t.refund_fee
        AND tk.source_tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tk.source_satellite_id=t.source_satellite_id
        -- Only the original direct award is admitted here. A replacement
        -- ticket still requires its distinct original refund disposition.
        AND tk.source_refund_entitlement_id IS NULL
        AND a.tournament_id=tk.source_satellite_id AND a.place=tk.source_satellite_award_place
        AND a.user_id=t.user_id AND a.delivery_kind='ticket' AND a.amount=t.gross AND a.payout_source='satellite_ticket'
        AND p.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND p.user_id=a.user_id AND p.amount=a.amount
        AND p.source=a.payout_source AND p.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key
        AND (p.position=a.place OR h.receipt_version>=3)
        AND h.target_id=t.tournament_id AND h.ticket_cost=t.gross
        AND h.target_buy_in=tk.entry_prize+tk.entry_bounty AND h.target_fee=tk.entry_fee
        AND issue.status='posted' AND issue.category='ticket_issue' AND issue.amount=t.gross
        AND issue.club_id=tk.club_id AND issue.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.from_type='prize_liability' AND issue.from_entity_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.to_type='escrow' AND issue.to_entity_id=tk.id
        AND issue.metadata->>'kind'='direct_satellite_entry_ticket'
        AND issue.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND issue.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'satellite_target_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND COALESCE(issue.metadata->>'position',issue.metadata->>'award_slot')=a.place::text
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_credit_idempotency w WHERE w.key=a.idempotency_key)
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions x
          WHERE x.transaction_type='tournament_ticket_issue' AND x.club_id=tk.club_id
           AND x.from_user_id IS NULL AND x.to_user_id=t.user_id AND x.amount=t.gross
           AND x.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND x.metadata->>'ledger_id'=issue.id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text AND x.metadata->>'idempotency_key'=a.idempotency_key
           AND x.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=a.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_award_place'=a.place::text)=1
        AND admission.status='posted' AND admission.category='ticket_redeem' AND admission.amount=t.gross
        AND admission.club_id=tk.club_id AND admission.tournament_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.from_type='escrow' AND admission.from_entity_id=tk.id
        AND admission.to_type='prize_liability' AND admission.to_entity_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.idempotency_key='ticket:'||tk.id::text||':tournament:'||t.tournament_id::text||':entry'
        AND admission.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND admission.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND admission.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'registration_id'=t.registration_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=t.source_satellite_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_prize'=to_jsonb(t.refund_prize)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_bounty'=to_jsonb(t.refund_bounty)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_fee'=to_jsonb(t.refund_fee))=1
     ELSE false END
  ) te ON true
 ), projected AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN bbj_payout IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_return' WHEN late_count=1 THEN 'cash_late_settlement' WHEN treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN treasury_return->>'status'='proven' THEN 'cash_return' WHEN cash_funding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR refunds=1 THEN 'cash_return'
    WHEN entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_funding' WHEN credit_id IS NOT NULL OR refund_ent IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_return' ELSE 'unsupported' END k,
   COALESCE(bbj_club,late_club,(treasury_gift->>'earning_club')::uuid,(treasury_return->>'earning_club')::uuid,cash_club,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_club WHEN owners=1 THEN return_club ELSE refund_club END,entry_club,credit_club,refund_ent_club) owner_club,
   COALESCE(bbj_user,late_user,(treasury_gift->>'user_id')::uuid,(treasury_return->>'user_id')::uuid,cash_user,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_user WHEN owners=1 THEN return_user ELSE refund_user END,entry_user,credit_user,refund_ent_user) owner_user
  FROM matched
 ) SELECT ledger_id,owner_club,owner_user,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta<0 THEN -late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_funding','tournament_funding') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta>0 THEN late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_return','tournament_return') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,k,
  (l->>'status'='posted' AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(l->'amount')>0 AND owner_club IS NOT NULL AND owner_user IS NOT NULL
   AND (owner_club::text=l->>'club_id' OR (treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' AND treasury_gift->>'ledger_id'=ledger_id::text AND treasury_gift->>'sponsor_bank_club'=l->>'club_id' AND treasury_gift->>'earning_club'=owner_club::text)) AND game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND CASE k
    WHEN 'cash_late_settlement' THEN late_count=1 AND abs(late_delta)=(l->>'amount')::numeric
    WHEN 'cash_funding' THEN (cash_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' AND (treasury_gift->>'amount')::numeric=(l->>'amount')::numeric)) AND l->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND l->>'category' IN('buyin','rebuy','addon','horse_funding')
    WHEN 'cash_return' THEN ((treasury_return->>'status'='proven' AND (treasury_return->>'amount')::numeric=(l->>'amount')::numeric) OR bbj_payout IS NOT NULL OR owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR (refunds=1 AND l->>'category'='player_funding')) AND l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND (l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
     OR (l->>'category'='player_funding' AND refunds=1 AND refund_club=owner_club AND refund_user=owner_user)
     OR (l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND bbj_payout IS NOT NULL AND bbj_club=owner_club AND bbj_user=owner_user))
    WHEN 'tournament_funding' THEN entry_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon')
    WHEN 'tournament_return' THEN (credit_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (credit_id IS NULL AND refund_ent IS NOT NULL)) AND l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_prize','prize','bounty','refund','tournament_refund')
    ELSE false END) IS TRUE
 FROM projected
;
$function$

smarter_private.weekly_hand_parts_reduce.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_hand_parts_reduce(p_union uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_projected boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY kind,club_id,user_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM(
 SELECT x.kind,x.club_id,x.user_id,sum(x.delta)delta,count(*)hands,sum(x.rake)rake
 FROM(SELECT h.hand_accepted_rake accepted_rake,h.hand_participants participants FROM public.fn_union_pnl_week_hand_lines(p_union,p_start,p_end,p_projected)h
 UNION ALL SELECT k.evidence->>'accepted_rake',k.evidence->'participants' FROM public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes(p_union,p_start,p_end)k)o
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT 0 kind,NULL::uuid club_id,NULL::uuid user_id,NULL::numeric delta,o.accepted_rake::numeric rake
 UNION ALL SELECT 1,(p->>'earning_club_id')::uuid,(p->>'user_id')::uuid,(p->>'observed_stack_delta')::numeric,NULL::numeric FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(o.participants,'[]'))p)x
 GROUP BY x.kind,x.club_id,x.user_id)q
$function$

smarter_private.weekly_hand_parts_witnes.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_hand_parts_witness(p_union uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_projected boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
DECLARE n bigint;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('session_replication_role') IS DISTINCT FROM 'origin'
 OR smarter_private.original_inventory_proof_sources_match() IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_hand_parts_original_sources_unqualified';END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM (VALUES ('public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready(text)','5f643c03d3595c20354d753087988476'),('public.fn_union_pnl_week_hand_lines(uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean)','9dee2921c7b956281be61a3eb9d7df6e'),('public.fn_accounting_close_windows(timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)','349f940293dfe6175faae2787840ede1'),('public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_participants(union_pnl_cash_outcomes)','2db7263f8d42e2e0e5a45b42b7198e4d'),('public.fn_union_pnl_posthand_escrow_touch(union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches)','e51decda42bbe46dd90aaf1bd3119023'),('public.fn_accounting_close_proof_lifetime()','80e026be0041fd1bdb04114c87ec368c'),('public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes(uuid,timestamptz,timestamptz)','798e8c95a26ad587da13151675f47fd1'),('public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_immutable()','307d83a1ee3d912bade24c48144aa801'),('smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificate_immutable()','14b1ddb37d4e3e83a9a42a34438e4b6e'))x(signature,hash) JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure(x.signature)
 WHERE p.proowner='postgres'::regrole AND md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))=x.hash;
 IF n IS DISTINCT FROM 9::bigint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_hand_parts_original_owners_changed';END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM(VALUES ('public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes','original_pnl_immutable',58,'public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_immutable()'),('public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches','original_pnl_immutable',58,'public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_immutable()'),('public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions','original_pnl_immutable',58,'public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_immutable()'),('smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates','posthand_escrow_certificate_immutable',31,'smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificate_immutable()'),('smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates','posthand_escrow_certificate_no_truncate',34,'smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificate_immutable()'))x(rel,name,kind,fn) JOIN pg_trigger t ON t.tgrelid=to_regclass(x.rel) AND t.tgname=x.name
 WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled IN('O','A') AND t.tgtype=x.kind AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure(x.fn) AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND t.tgnargs=0;
 IF n IS DISTINCT FROM 5::bigint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_hand_parts_append_only_contract_changed';END IF;
 IF p_projected IS DISTINCT FROM public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready('cash_outcome_touches') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_hand_parts_projection_changed';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ordinary_count',CASE WHEN p_projected THEN
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches h WHERE h.game_union_id=p_union::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end)
 ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes h WHERE h.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end) END,
 -- Link ownership comes from the immutable resolution, while recognition comes
 -- from the original outcome, exactly as the original linked reader requires.
 'links',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions r
 JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=r.table_id AND o.hand_number=r.hand_number
 WHERE r.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union::text AND o.recognized_at>=p_start AND o.recognized_at<p_end),
 -- Only certificates consulted by the ordinary reader can change this window.
 -- Linked outcomes carry their original resolved evidence and do not read these.
 'escrow_certificates',CASE WHEN p_projected THEN
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches h
 JOIN smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates c ON c.table_id=h.table_id AND c.hand_number=h.hand_number
 WHERE h.game_union_id=p_union::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end)
 ELSE(SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes h
 JOIN smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates c ON c.table_id=h.table_id AND c.hand_number=h.hand_number
 WHERE h.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union::text AND h.recognized_at>=p_start AND h.recognized_at<p_end)END);
END $function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_claims_mat.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_claims_match(p_instance text, p_claims jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- AN EMPTY FLEET IS A TRUTHFUL CLAIM (20261102202312): an empty list is not
 -- refused here; it passes only if the coverage test below finds no live lease.
 IF NULLIF(btrim(p_instance),'') IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_claims) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j
   WHERE j->>'scope' NOT IN('cash','tournament') OR j->>'scope' IS NULL OR j->>'lease_generation' IS NULL
    OR CASE WHEN j->>'scope'='cash' THEN j->>'table_id' IS NULL OR j->>'tournament_id' IS NOT NULL
      ELSE j->>'tournament_id' IS NULL OR j->>'table_id' IS NOT NULL END)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j GROUP BY j->>'scope',COALESCE(j->>'table_id',j->>'tournament_id') HAVING count(*)<>1)
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 -- A single current process must account for the complete live fleet. An
 -- unknown second process is an explicit refusal, never an omitted scope.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.engine_table_leases l
   WHERE l.heartbeat_at>=smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()-interval '30 seconds'
    AND (l.instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_instance OR l.protocol_version<>2
     OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j
      WHERE j->>'scope'='cash' AND (j->>'table_id')::uuid=l.table_id
       AND (j->>'lease_generation')::uuid=l.lease_generation)))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.engine_tournament_leases l
   WHERE l.heartbeat_at>=smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()-interval '30 seconds'
    AND (l.instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_instance OR l.protocol_version<>2
     OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j
      WHERE j->>'scope'='tournament' AND (j->>'tournament_id')::uuid=l.tournament_id
       AND (j->>'lease_generation')::uuid=l.lease_generation)))
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j WHERE
  CASE WHEN j->>'scope'='cash' THEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.engine_table_leases l
    WHERE l.table_id=(j->>'table_id')::uuid AND l.instance_id=p_instance
     AND l.lease_generation=(j->>'lease_generation')::uuid AND l.protocol_version=2
     AND l.heartbeat_at>=smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()-interval '30 seconds')
   ELSE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.engine_tournament_leases l
    WHERE l.tournament_id=(j->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND l.instance_id=p_instance
     AND l.lease_generation=(j->>'lease_generation')::uuid AND l.protocol_version=2
     AND l.heartbeat_at>=smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()-interval '30 seconds') END)
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$SELECT clock_timestamp()$function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_eligible_s.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_eligible_scopes(p_end timestamp with time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, id uuid, first_week timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_to timestamptz:=p_end;v_now timestamptz:=p_now;v_chunked boolean:=true;
BEGIN
 IF md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.fn_process_weekly_accounting_scope(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure))<>'4179282ab83f30094d4c3b2885102917'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_payout_original_scope_authority_changed' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
WITH cash_clubs AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT DISTINCT s.club_id FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s
          WHERE s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL AND s.earned_at<v_to
        ), cash_cutoffs AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT c.club_id,public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('club',c.club_id) AS cutoff FROM cash_clubs c
        ), standalone_earned AS (
          SELECT s.club_id,s.earned_at FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources s
          LEFT JOIN cash_cutoffs c ON c.club_id=s.club_id
          WHERE s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL AND s.earned_at<v_to
            AND CASE WHEN c.cutoff IS NULL THEN true
              ELSE s.earned_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(s.earned_at) AND s.earned_at>=c.cutoff END
          UNION ALL
          -- STANDALONE TOURNAMENT EARNINGS ARE READ PER CLUB (20261022150614): this branch
          -- used to read the tournament_fee_accrual half of
          -- accounting_payable_earning_sources for every source row on every tick
          -- (1.7M recognition probes, 10 s warm and over 100 s cold), which spent
          -- the close attempt's own 3-minute budget before the attempt began.
          -- The predicate below is that view branch verbatim, read per club from
          -- the club's own standalone fee rows. Only eligible below reads these
          -- rows, as GREATEST(first week, the club's settlement floor) for clubs
          -- that are not unions, so a club with any such earning before its floor
          -- contributes the floor itself and is not read further; any other club
          -- contributes its earliest earning (and earliest finite one).
          SELECT tc.id AS club_id,te.earned_at FROM public.clubs tc
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_club_settlement_floor_week(tc.id) AS floor) tf
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN tf.floor IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1
              FROM (SELECT s.id,s.tournament_id,s.club_id,s.union_id,s.charged_at,s.rake_credit FROM public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources s
                     WHERE s.club_id=tc.id AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL OFFSET 0) s
              JOIN public.accounting_tournament_recognized_sources rs ON rs.source_id=s.id AND rs.tournament_id=s.tournament_id
              JOIN public.accounting_tournament_fee_recognitions r ON r.tournament_id=s.tournament_id
              LEFT JOIN public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_club_cutoffs() bd(club_id,cutoff_at) ON bd.club_id=s.club_id
              WHERE (bd.cutoff_at IS NULL OR s.charged_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(s.charged_at) AND s.charged_at>=bd.cutoff_at)
                AND (bd.cutoff_at IS NULL OR rs.recognized_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(rs.recognized_at) AND rs.recognized_at>=bd.cutoff_at)
                AND rs.disposition='earned' AND r.status='recognized' AND rs.rake_credit=s.rake_credit AND rs.recognized_at=r.recognized_at
                AND NOT s.union_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.union_id AND rs.recognized_at<v_to AND rs.recognized_at<tf.floor)
            THEN tf.floor END AS clamp) tk
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT tk.clamp AS earned_at WHERE tk.clamp IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT tm.earned_at FROM (SELECT min(rs.recognized_at) AS m,min(rs.recognized_at) FILTER(WHERE isfinite(rs.recognized_at)) AS mf
              FROM (SELECT s.id,s.tournament_id,s.club_id,s.union_id,s.charged_at,s.rake_credit FROM public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources s
                     WHERE s.club_id=tc.id AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NULL OFFSET 0) s
              JOIN public.accounting_tournament_recognized_sources rs ON rs.source_id=s.id AND rs.tournament_id=s.tournament_id
              JOIN public.accounting_tournament_fee_recognitions r ON r.tournament_id=s.tournament_id
              LEFT JOIN public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_club_cutoffs() bd(club_id,cutoff_at) ON bd.club_id=s.club_id
              WHERE tk.clamp IS NULL AND (bd.cutoff_at IS NULL OR s.charged_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(s.charged_at) AND s.charged_at>=bd.cutoff_at)
                AND (bd.cutoff_at IS NULL OR rs.recognized_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(rs.recognized_at) AND rs.recognized_at>=bd.cutoff_at)
                AND rs.disposition='earned' AND r.status='recognized' AND rs.rake_credit=s.rake_credit AND rs.recognized_at=r.recognized_at
                AND NOT s.union_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.union_id AND rs.recognized_at<v_to) ta
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(ta.m),(ta.mf)) tm(earned_at) WHERE tm.earned_at IS NOT NULL) te
          WHERE tc.is_union IS NOT TRUE
        ), standalone_work AS (
          SELECT s.club_id,LEAST(public.fn_union_week_start(min(s.earned_at) FILTER(WHERE isfinite(s.earned_at))),min(s.earned_at)) AS first_week
           FROM standalone_earned s GROUP BY s.club_id
          UNION ALL SELECT q.standalone_club_id,q.period_start FROM public.union_accounting_runs q
           WHERE q.standalone_club_id IS NOT NULL AND q.status<>'complete'
          UNION ALL SELECT q.standalone_club_id,q.period_start FROM public.union_accounting_runs q
           WHERE q.standalone_club_id IS NOT NULL AND q.status='complete' AND q.period_end<v_to
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_accounting_runs later
              WHERE later.standalone_club_id=q.standalone_club_id AND later.period_end>q.period_end)
          UNION ALL SELECT rp.club_id,min(public.fn_union_week_start(rp.period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'))
           FROM public.rakeback_periods rp WHERE rp.status='pending' AND rp.period_end<(v_to AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_clubs uc WHERE uc.club_id=rp.club_id) GROUP BY rp.club_id
          UNION ALL SELECT a.club_id,public.fn_union_prev_week_start(v_now) FROM public.agents a
           WHERE NOT COALESCE(a.is_prepaid,false) AND a.credit_limit>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_clubs uc WHERE uc.club_id=a.club_id)
        ), union_floors AS (
          SELECT u.id,f.earliest_period_start,CASE WHEN f.earliest_period_start IS NULL THEN public.fn_union_prev_week_start(v_now)
             WHEN public.fn_union_week_start(f.earliest_period_start)<f.earliest_period_start
              THEN public.fn_union_week_start(public.fn_union_week_start(f.earliest_period_start)+interval '8 days')
             ELSE public.fn_union_week_start(f.earliest_period_start) END AS first_week
           FROM public.unions u LEFT JOIN public.union_settlement_floor f ON f.union_id=u.id
        ), union_work AS (
          SELECT u.id,LEAST(u.first_week,(SELECT min(q.period_start) FROM public.union_accounting_runs q
            WHERE q.union_id=u.id
              AND (q.status<>'complete' OR (u.earliest_period_start IS NULL
                AND q.status='complete' AND q.result->>'success'='true' AND q.result->>'accounting_version'='3'))
              AND (u.earliest_period_start IS NULL OR q.period_start>=u.first_week))) AS first_week
           FROM union_floors u
        ), eligible AS (
          -- Match the exact-scope floor rounding and per-week due check. An
          -- older union backlog remains due before this Monday's new close.
          SELECT 'union'::text AS kind,w.id FROM union_work w WHERE w.first_week<v_to
           AND v_now>=CASE WHEN v_chunked THEN public.fn_union_week_start(w.first_week+interval '8 days') ELSE public.fn_union_accounting_run_at(public.fn_union_week_start(w.first_week+interval '8 days')) END
          UNION ALL SELECT 'club',w.club_id FROM standalone_work w JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id=w.club_id
           WHERE c.is_union IS NOT TRUE
            -- A RETIRED CLUB OPENS NO EMPTY WEEK (20261031): once its last close is
            -- complete and nothing has been earned since, its books are finished.
            -- The retirement guard refuses a new settlement period for it anyway.
            AND NOT (c.lifecycle_status='retired'
              AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_accounting_runs rq WHERE rq.standalone_club_id=c.id AND rq.status<>'complete')
              AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounting_cash_rake_sources rs WHERE rs.club_id=c.id
                AND rs.earned_at>=COALESCE((SELECT max(rq.period_end) FROM public.union_accounting_runs rq WHERE rq.standalone_club_id=c.id AND rq.status='complete'),'-infinity'::timestamptz))
              AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources ts WHERE ts.club_id=c.id
                AND ts.charged_at>=COALESCE((SELECT max(rq.period_end) FROM public.union_accounting_runs rq WHERE rq.standalone_club_id=c.id AND rq.status='complete'),'-infinity'::timestamptz)))
            AND GREATEST(w.first_week,public.fn_club_settlement_floor_week(w.club_id))<v_to
            AND v_now>=CASE WHEN v_chunked THEN public.fn_union_week_start(GREATEST(w.first_week,public.fn_club_settlement_floor_week(w.club_id))+interval '8 days') ELSE public.fn_union_accounting_run_at(public.fn_union_week_start(GREATEST(w.first_week,public.fn_club_settlement_floor_week(w.club_id))+interval '8 days')) END GROUP BY w.club_id
        )
 SELECT e.kind,e.id,CASE WHEN e.kind='union' THEN (SELECT min(w.first_week) FROM union_work w WHERE w.id=e.id)
  ELSE (SELECT min(GREATEST(w.first_week,public.fn_club_settlement_floor_week(w.club_id))) FROM standalone_work w WHERE w.club_id=e.id) END
 FROM eligible e ORDER BY (e.kind='union') DESC,e.id;
END $function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_finalize(p.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_finalize(p_run uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.weekly_accounting_payout_pauses%ROWTYPE; item jsonb; d_from date; summary jsonb; cfg smarter_private.weekly_payout_rounds_config%ROWTYPE; notes int; label text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM public.weekly_accounting_payout_pauses WHERE run_id=p_run FOR UPDATE;
 IF r.phase='released' THEN RETURN r.result; END IF;
 d_from:=(r.period_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date;
 label:=to_char(r.period_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago','Mon DD')||' - '||to_char((r.period_end-interval '1 second') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago','Mon DD');
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.scope_plan) LOOP
  INSERT INTO smarter_private.weekly_payout_financial_receipts(scope_kind,scope_id,period_start,period_end,run_id,original_round_receipts)
  SELECT item->>'kind',(item->>'id')::uuid,r.period_start,r.period_end,r.run_id,
   (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('scope',item,'round',x.round_no,'receipt',x.receipt) ORDER BY x.round_no) FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_round_receipts x
     WHERE x.run_id=r.run_id AND x.scope_kind=item->>'kind' AND x.scope_id=(item->>'id')::uuid)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_financial_receipts f WHERE f.scope_kind=item->>'kind' AND f.scope_id=(item->>'id')::uuid AND f.period_end=r.period_end);
 END LOOP;
 -- Credit lines: what an agent owes is its credit line minus the chips in its agent wallet after rakeback.
 UPDATE public.credit_invoices ci SET debt_owed=round(a.credit_limit-a.agent_wallet_balance,2),amount_remaining=round(a.credit_limit-a.agent_wallet_balance,2)
 FROM public.agents a WHERE a.id=ci.agent_id AND ci.period_end=r.period_end AND ci.status='pending' AND ci.amount_paid=0 AND a.credit_limit-a.agent_wallet_balance>0;
 UPDATE public.credit_invoices ci SET status='void',void_reason='Agent wallet covers the credit line after weekly rakeback',debt_owed=0,amount_remaining=0
 FROM public.agents a WHERE a.id=ci.agent_id AND ci.period_end=r.period_end AND ci.status='pending' AND ci.amount_paid=0 AND a.credit_limit-a.agent_wallet_balance<=0;
 -- Rakeback Received: every player, agent and club owner that was paid.
 WITH players AS (SELECT pp.user_id,pp.club_id,round(sum(pp.payout_amount),2) amt FROM public.rakeback_periods rp JOIN public.rakeback_period_payouts pp ON pp.rakeback_period_id=rp.id
   WHERE rp.period_start=d_from AND pp.payout_amount>0 AND pp.paid_at>=r.money_starts_at GROUP BY 1,2),
 agents AS (SELECT a.user_id,a.club_id,round(sum(a.amount),2) amt FROM public.agent_commission_settlements a WHERE a.period_start=r.period_start GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING sum(a.amount)>0),
 owners AS (SELECT c.owner_id user_id,c.id club_id,si.gross_amount amt FROM public.settlement_invoices si JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id::text=si.to_entity_id::text
   WHERE si.invoice_type='union_to_club' AND si.created_at>=r.money_starts_at AND si.gross_amount>0),
 allrows AS (SELECT user_id,club_id,amt,'player' k FROM players UNION ALL SELECT user_id,club_id,amt,'agent' FROM agents UNION ALL SELECT user_id,club_id,amt,'club' FROM owners)
 INSERT INTO public.notifications(user_id,type,title,message,data,link)
 SELECT x.user_id,'rakeback_received',
  CASE x.k WHEN 'player' THEN 'Weekly Rakeback Received' WHEN 'agent' THEN 'Weekly Agent Rakeback Received' ELSE 'Weekly Club Rakeback Received' END,
  CASE x.k WHEN 'player' THEN 'Your weekly rakeback of '||to_char(x.amt,'FM999,999,990.00')||' chips from '||c.name||' ('||label||') was added to your wallet.'
   WHEN 'agent' THEN 'Your weekly agent rakeback of '||to_char(x.amt,'FM999,999,990.00')||' chips from '||c.name||' ('||label||') was added to your agent wallet.'
   ELSE c.name||' received its weekly rakeback of '||to_char(x.amt,'FM999,999,990.00')||' chips from the union ('||label||') in the club bank.' END,
  jsonb_build_object('club_id',x.club_id,'amount',x.amt,'kind',x.k,'period_start',d_from::text,'run_id',r.run_id),'/club/'||x.club_id
 FROM allrows x JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id=x.club_id
 WHERE x.user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.notifications n WHERE n.user_id=x.user_id AND n.type='rakeback_received' AND n.data->>'club_id'=x.club_id::text AND n.data->>'kind'=x.k AND n.data->>'period_start'=d_from::text);
 GET DIAGNOSTICS notes=ROW_COUNT;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('rounds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('scope_kind',x.scope_kind,'scope_id',x.scope_id,'round',x.round_no,
   'amount',COALESCE((x.receipt->>'amount')::numeric,(x.receipt->>'total_rakeback')::numeric,0),'payees',COALESCE((x.receipt->>'payees')::int,(x.receipt->>'clubs_paid')::int,0),'funding',x.funding) ORDER BY x.round_no,x.scope_kind)
   FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_round_receipts x WHERE x.run_id=r.run_id),'notifications',notes) INTO summary;
 UPDATE public.weekly_accounting_payout_pauses SET phase='released',result=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'paid',true,'stage','weekly_payout_financial_complete','run_id',r.run_id,
  'attempt_no',r.attempt_no,'financial_finished_at',clock_timestamp(),'books_complete',false,'round_runner',true)||summary WHERE run_id=r.run_id;
 SELECT * INTO cfg FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_rounds_config WHERE singleton;
 IF cfg.report_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  INSERT INTO public.notifications(user_id,type,title,message,data,link)
  VALUES(cfg.report_user_id,'weekly_payout_report','Weekly Rakeback Completed',
   'Weekly rakeback for '||label||' is paid: clubs '||to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum((x.receipt->>'total_rakeback')::numeric) FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_round_receipts x WHERE x.run_id=r.run_id AND x.round_no=1),0),'FM999,999,990.00')
   ||', agents '||to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum((x.receipt->>'amount')::numeric) FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_round_receipts x WHERE x.run_id=r.run_id AND x.round_no=2),0),'FM999,999,990.00')
   ||', players '||to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum((x.receipt->>'amount')::numeric) FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_round_receipts x WHERE x.run_id=r.run_id AND x.round_no=3),0),'FM999,999,990.00')||'.',
   summary||jsonb_build_object('run_id',r.run_id,'period_start',d_from::text),'/hub');
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('stage','weekly_payout_finalized','run_id',r.run_id)||summary;
END $function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_lost_money.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_lost_money_run(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
-- The scheduler's own durable record of a run of the original weekly tick that
-- started inside an owned money window and did not succeed (statement
-- timeout, crash or restart). NULL when none did, or with no scheduler record.
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF to_regclass('cron.job_run_details') IS NULL OR to_regclass('cron.job') IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 EXECUTE $q$SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (SELECT d.jobid,d.runid,d.status,left(d.return_message,300) AS return_message,d.start_time,d.end_time
   FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid=d.jobid
   WHERE strpos(j.command,'fn_union_settlement_cascade_due()')>0
    AND d.start_time>=$1-interval '5 seconds' AND d.start_time<$2 AND d.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'succeeded'
    AND (d.end_time IS NOT NULL OR d.start_time<clock_timestamp()-interval '300 seconds')
   ORDER BY d.start_time LIMIT 1) x$q$ INTO v USING p_from,p_to;
 RETURN v;
END $function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_owned_mone.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_owned_money_write(p_table text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_table=ANY(ARRAY['clubs','agents','club_members','chip_ledger','chip_transactions','wallet_transactions','union_wallets','wallets'])
 AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_owned_transactions c
  WHERE c.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND c.transaction_id=txid_current()
   AND smarter_private.weekly_payout_owns_round(c.scope_kind,c.scope_id,c.period_start,c.period_end,c.round_no))
$function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_owns_round.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_owns_round(p_kind text, p_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_round integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_owned_transactions c
  JOIN public.weekly_accounting_payout_pauses r ON r.run_id=c.run_id
  WHERE c.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND c.transaction_id=txid_current()
   AND c.scope_kind=p_kind AND c.scope_id=p_id AND c.period_start=p_from AND c.period_end=p_to AND c.round_no=p_round
   AND r.phase='paying' AND r.acknowledged_at>=r.announced_at AND r.acknowledged_at<r.money_deadline_at
   AND smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()>=r.money_starts_at
   AND smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()<r.money_deadline_at
   AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.scope_plan) j WHERE j->>'kind'=p_kind AND (j->>'id')::uuid=p_id
    AND (j->>'period_start')::timestamptz=p_from AND (j->>'period_end')::timestamptz=p_to))
$function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_pause_json.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_pause_json(p_row weekly_accounting_payout_pauses)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('contract','weekly-payout-owned-phase-v1',
  'observed_at',smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock(),
  'boundary',CASE WHEN p_row.run_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
   'run_id',p_row.run_id,'ownership_token',p_row.ownership_token,
   'scope_kind','global','scope_id',p_row.run_id,
   'period_start',p_row.period_start,'period_end',p_row.period_end,
   'announced_at',p_row.announced_at,'money_starts_at',p_row.money_starts_at,
   'money_deadline_at',p_row.money_deadline_at,'expires_at',p_row.expires_at,
   'phase',CASE WHEN smarter_private.weekly_payout_clock()>=p_row.expires_at THEN 'released' ELSE p_row.phase END
  )END)
$function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_record_cla.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_record_claims(p_run uuid, p_instance text, p_claims jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO smarter_private.weekly_payout_claim_diagnostics(run_id,instance_id,claims,unclaimed_cash,unclaimed_tournaments,claimed_without_lease,other_instances,strict_match)
 SELECT p_run,p_instance,p_claims,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_id',l.table_id,'gen',l.lease_generation,'acquired',l.acquired_at)) FROM public.engine_table_leases l
    WHERE l.heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j WHERE j->>'scope'='cash' AND (j->>'table_id')::uuid=l.table_id AND (j->>'lease_generation')::uuid=l.lease_generation)),
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tournament_id',l.tournament_id,'gen',l.lease_generation,'acquired',l.acquired_at)) FROM public.engine_tournament_leases l
    WHERE l.heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j WHERE j->>'scope'='tournament' AND (j->>'tournament_id')::uuid=l.tournament_id AND (j->>'lease_generation')::uuid=l.lease_generation)),
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(j) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) j WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.engine_table_leases l WHERE j->>'scope'='cash' AND l.table_id=(j->>'table_id')::uuid AND l.lease_generation=(j->>'lease_generation')::uuid AND l.heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.engine_tournament_leases l WHERE j->>'scope'='tournament' AND l.tournament_id=(j->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND l.lease_generation=(j->>'lease_generation')::uuid AND l.heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds')),
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT x) FROM (SELECT instance_id||'/'||protocol_version x FROM public.engine_table_leases WHERE heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds' UNION SELECT instance_id||'/'||protocol_version FROM public.engine_tournament_leases WHERE heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds') z),
  smarter_private.weekly_payout_claims_match(p_instance,p_claims);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END $function$

smarter_private.weekly_payout_require_ro.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.weekly_payout_require_round(p_kind text, p_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_round integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- This change never reinterprets an old paid contract or the incident week.
 IF p_to<(SELECT cutover_period_end FROM smarter_private.weekly_payout_phase_configuration WHERE singleton) THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF NOT smarter_private.weekly_payout_owns_round(p_kind,p_id,p_from,p_to,p_round) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'weekly_payout_original_owned_phase_required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 PERFORM public.fn_weekly_accounting_deadline_check();
END $function$
